Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Translational Medicine Expert (TME) you will provide medical and scientific expertise and leadership to:
• Drive success of early global programs, develop and implement strategies to achieve Transition Decision Point (TDP)
• Drive success of late global programs by developing and implementing strategies, which lead to clinical pharmacology and profiling packages that meet regulatory requirements and support differentiated and competitive drug labeling.
• Support Translational Research in developing new indications, endpoints and biomarkers, using in vitro, in vivo, or in silico methods.
• Provide scientific expert assessments and support for in-licensing opportunities, including due diligences.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Early clinical projects (Phase I / II, “Discovery”):
Develop, in collaboration with the dermatology TA and work with teams to carry out, strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects from Research to TDP in single or multiple indications, including post-indication expansion (PIE) projects.

Late-stage clinical projects (post-TDP, “Profiling”):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head: Act as a key leader in developing the Ph2-3 and post-approval profiling strategy for drug programs, representing TMDP on Global Project Team (GPT) along with other TM line functions. Provide support for dose selection, study design and other clinical pharmacology matters throughout the development cycle. Oversee conduct and interpretation of studies prioritized by the to support the pivotal trials, such as special populations, drug-drug interactions, mechanism of action assessments, Pediatric Investigational Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; indication seeking, endpoint and biomarker development):
In collaboration with the dermatology TA Head, BR Research scientists, other TM line functions (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), develop strategies to identify initial or expansion (PIE) indications, and to obtain sufficient evidence to fund these ideas.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; in-licensing and out licensing compounds):
Participate on BD&L teams as the TM representative.

General responsibilities:

• Responsible for clinical monitoring and integrated safety data review during and after the live phase of a study.

• Provides medical and scientific leadership and expertise to all line functions on the study team.

• Represent clinical Translational Medicine aspects to Health Authorities and other stakeholders (e.g. payers, patient advocacy groups).

• Oversee publication strategy for TM studies; lead writing of scientific publications; present study results externally where appropriate

Leadership:

• Lead study-specific teams/ clinical trial teams in partnership with other line functions.

• Lead BR-sub-team(s) on Global Project Teams for late-phase programs

• Collaborate closely with other TM (especially CS&I) and non-TM (especially Project Management) line functions to ensure operational excellence, continued urgency, and close attention to timelines, costs, and subject burden in balance with high scientific standards and innovation

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD

• Board certified Dermatologist

• Preferably Ph.D. within dermatology/immunology

• At least 5 years’ experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech company, CRO, or academic medical center, or related experience

• Innovation: Seeks out new clinical discovery opportunities and approaches to reach TDP

• Recognized expert in field, driving success for individual studies and projects; respected by colleagues across R&D, Development, and externally

• Fluent oral and written English

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Descrizione del lavoro Riepilogo #LI-Hybrid Ubicazione: Basel, Switzerland

Come esperto di medicina traslazionale (TME) fornirete competenze mediche e scientifiche e leadership per: - Guidare il successo dei primi programmi globali, sviluppare e attuare strategie per raggiungere Transition Decision Point (TDP) - Guidare il successo dei programmi di fine globale sviluppando e implementando strategie, che portano alla farmacologia clinica e pacchetti di affrancatura che soddisfano i requisiti normativi e supportano l'etichettatura differenziata e competitiva dei farmaci. - Supporto Ricerca traslazionale nello sviluppo di nuove indicazioni, endpoint e biomarcatori, utilizzando metodi in vitro, in vivo o in silico.

- fornire valutazioni scientifiche di esperti e sostegno per le opportunità di licenza, comprese le dovute diligence.

Descrizione del lavoro

Responsabilità chiave: Progetti clinici precoci (fase I / II, Discovery.): - Sviluppare, in collaborazione con la dermatologia TA e lavorare con team per effettuare, strategie per la componente Medicina Traduttiva dei progetti di sviluppo di droga dalla Ricerca al TDP in singole o multiple indicazioni, compresi i progetti di espansione post-indicazione (PIE).

Progetti clinici in fase di Late (post-TDP,.Profilo.): - In collaborazione con la dermatologia TA Head: Agire come leader chiave nello sviluppo della strategia Ph2-3 e post-approvazione di ragonaggio per i programmi antidroga, rappresentando TMDP sul Global Project Team (GPT) insieme ad altre funzioni della linea TM. - Fornire supporto per la selezione della dose, la progettazione dello studio e altre questioni di farmacologia clinica durante il ciclo di sviluppo.

- Sopravvivere la condotta e l'interpretazione degli studi prioritarizzati dalla sperimentazione pilota, quali popolazioni speciali, interazioni farmaco-farmaco, meccanismi di valutazione dell'azione, Piano di indagine pediatrica, ecc.

Ricerca traslazionale (TR; ricerca di indicazioni, endpoint e sviluppo di biomarcatori): - In collaborazione con la responsabile della dermatologia TA, BR Research scientists, altre funzioni della linea TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), sviluppare strategie per identificare le indicazioni iniziali o di espansione (PIE) e per ottenere prove sufficienti per finanziare queste idee.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; componenti per la licenza in licenza e fuori): - Partecipa alle squadre BD&L in qualità di rappresentante del TM.

Responsabilità generali: - Responsabile del monitoraggio clinico e della revisione integrata dei dati di sicurezza durante e dopo la fase in cui si svolge uno studio. - Fornisce la leadership medica e scientifica e la competenza a tutte le funzioni di linea del gruppo di studio. - Rappresentare aspetti clinici della medicina traslazionale alle autorità sanitarie e ad altre parti interessate (ad esempio i contribuenti, i gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti). - Superare la strategia di pubblicazione per gli studi sulla TM; scrivere testate scientifiche; presentare i risultati dello studio esternamente, ove opportuno.

Leadership: - Lead team di studio specifici/squadre di studi clinici in collaborazione con altre funzioni di linea. - Lead BR-sub-team (s) sui team di progetto globali per programmi in fase avanzata - Collaborazione strettamente con altre funzioni di linea TM (in particolare CS&I) e non-TM (in particolare Project Management) per garantire l'eccellenza operativa, la continuità dell'urgenza e la stretta attenzione alle linee temporali, ai costi e agli oneri soggettivi in equilibrio con elevati standard scientifici e innovazione

Requisiti essenziali: - Dottorato, MD - Dermatologa certificata da consiglio - Preferibilmente Ph.D. in dermatologia/immunologia - Almeno 5 anni. esperienza in una società farmaceutica/biotech, CRO, o centro medico accademico, o esperienza correlata - Innovazione: Cerca nuove opportunità di scoperta clinica e approcci per raggiungere TDP - Esperto riconosciuto sul campo, guidando il successo per studi e progetti individuali; rispettato dai colleghi in tutto R&D, Sviluppo, ed esternamente - Fluente orale e scritto inglese

Vantaggi e premi In Novartis, ci siamo impegnati a reimmaginare la medicina insieme e a ricompensare le persone che la fanno accadere.

Range annuale di base previsto per il ruolo: - 122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annua

Jobbeschreibung Zusammenfassung #LI-Hybrid Ort: Basel, Schweiz

Als Translational Medicine Expert (TME) bieten Sie medizinische und wissenschaftliche Expertise und Führung bei: - Führen Sie den Erfolg von frühen globalen Programmen, entwickeln und implementieren Sie Strategien, um Transition Decision Point (TDP) zu erreichen - Antrieb Erfolg von späten globalen Programmen durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die zu klinischen Pharmakologie und Profiling-Pakete führen, die regulatorische Anforderungen erfüllen und differenzierte und wettbewerbsfähige Arzneimittelkennzeichnung unterstützen. - Unterstützung Translational Research bei der Entwicklung neuer Indikationen, Endpunkte und Biomarker, mit In-vitro, in vivo oder in Silico-Methoden.

- Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Expertenbewertungen und Unterstützung für die Lizenzvergabe, einschließlich Due Diligences.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Wichtige Aufgaben: Frühe klinische Projekte (Phase I / II,,Discovery,): - Entwickeln Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA und arbeiten Sie mit Teams an der Durchführung, Strategien für die Translational Medicine Komponente von Medikamentenentwicklungsprojekten von Forschung bis TDP in einzelnen oder mehreren Indikationen, einschließlich Post-Indikations-Erweiterung (PIE) Projekte.

Spätphasen-Klinische Projekte (nach TDP,, ), : - In Zusammenarbeit mit der Dermatologie TA Head: Act als ein wichtiger Führer bei der Entwicklung der Ph2-3 und Post-Genehmigung Profiling-Strategie für Arzneimittel-Programme, die TMDP auf Global Project Team (GPT) zusammen mit anderen TM-Linie Funktionen. - Unterstützung für die Dosisauswahl, Studiendesign und andere klinische Pharmakologie Fragen während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus.

- Überwachen Sie die Durchführung und Interpretation von Studien, die von der Unterstützung der zentralen Studien priorisiert wurden, wie spezielle Populationen, Arzneimittel-Drogen-Interaktionen, Mechanismus der Wirkungsbewertungen, Pediatric Investigation Plan, etc.

Translational Research (TR; Indikationssuche, Endpunkt- und Biomarkerentwicklung): - In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Dermatologie-TA-Leiter, BR-Forschungswissenschaftlern, anderen TM-Line-Funktionen (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), entwickeln Strategien zur Identifizierung von Initial- oder Expansions-Indikationen (PIE) und zur Erlangung ausreichender Nachweise, um diese Ideen zu finanzieren.

Business Development and Licensing (BD&L; In-Lizenzierung und Ausverkauf von Lizenzierungs-Compounds): - Nehmen Sie als TM-Vertreter an BD&L-Teams teil.

Allgemeine Verantwortung: - Verantwortlich für die klinische Überwachung und integrierte Sicherheitsdatenüberprüfung während und nach der Live-Phase einer Studie. - Bietet medizinische und wissenschaftliche Führung und Expertise für alle Leitungsfunktionen im Studienteam. - Vertreten klinische Translational Medicine Aspekte für Gesundheitsbehörden und andere Stakeholder (z.B. Zahler, Patienten-Advocacy-Gruppen). - Überwachen Sie die Publikationsstrategie für TM-Studien; Leadwriting von wissenschaftlichen Publikationen; präsentieren Sie Studienergebnisse extern, wenn angemessen

Führung: - Leitungsteams/ klinische Testteams in Partnerschaft mit anderen Leitungsfunktionen. - Leitungsteams für BR-Teilteams im Global Project Teams für Spätphasenprogramme - enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen TM (insbesondere CS&I) und Nicht-TM (insbesondere Projektmanagement)-Linienfunktionen, um operative Exzellenz, anhaltende Dringlichkeit und die Aufmerksamkeit auf Zeitlinien, Kosten und Themenlast im Einklang mit hohen wissenschaftlichen Standards und Innovationen zu gewährleisten

Grundlegende Voraussetzungen: - Doktorat, MD - Vorstand zertifiziert Dermatologe - Vorzugsweise Doktorat in der Dermatologie/Immunologie - Mindestens 5 Jahre, Erfahrung in einem Pharma-/Biotech-Unternehmen, CRO, oder akademische medizinische Zentrum, oder verwandte Erfahrung - Innovation: Suche nach neuen klinischen Entdeckungsmöglichkeiten und Ansätzen, um TDP zu erreichen - Erkannter Experte im Bereich, Antriebserfolg für einzelne Studien und Projekte; von Kollegen in Forschung und Entwicklung, Entwicklung und extern respektiert - Fluent oral und schriftlich Englisch

Vorteile & Belohnungen Bei Novartis sind wir verpflichtet, die Medizin zusammen neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die es geschehen lassen.

Erwartete Jahresbasis Gehaltsspanne für die Rolle: - 122.500.00 - 227.500.00 CHF Annua

Description de l'emploi Résumé #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

En tant qu'expert en médecine translationnelle, vous fournirez une expertise médicale et scientifique et un leadership pour : - favoriser la réussite des premiers programmes mondiaux, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies pour atteindre le point de décision de transition (DPT) - favoriser la réussite des programmes mondiaux tardifs en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies qui mènent à la pharmacologie clinique et à des ensembles de profilage qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires et qui appuient l'étiquetage différencié et concurrentiel des médicaments. - appuyer la recherche translationnelle dans l'élaboration de nouvelles indications, critères et biomarqueurs, en utilisant des méthodes in vitro, in vivo ou silico.

- Fournir des évaluations scientifiques et un soutien pour les possibilités de licence, y compris des diligences raisonnables.

Description de l'emploi

Principales responsabilités : Projets cliniques précoces (phase I / II,, Découverte) : - Élaborer, en collaboration avec l'AT dermatologique et travailler avec des équipes pour réaliser, des stratégies pour la composante Médecine Translationnelle des projets de développement de médicaments de la recherche au PDT en une ou plusieurs indications, y compris des projets d'expansion post-Digération (EIP).

Projets cliniques en fin de cycle (après le PDT,,Profilage) : - En collaboration avec le responsable de l'AT de dermatologie : Agir comme chef de file dans l'élaboration de la stratégie de profilage des médicaments Ph2-3 et post-approbation, représentant le PDTG au sein de l'équipe de projet mondial (GPT) et d'autres fonctions de ligne de TG. - Fournir un soutien pour la sélection des doses, la conception des études et d'autres questions de pharmacologie clinique tout au long du cycle de développement.

- Superviser la conduite et l'interprétation des études prioritaires par les essais pivots, tels que les populations spéciales, les interactions drogues-médicaments, le mécanisme d'évaluation des mesures, le Plan d'investigation pédiatrique, etc.

Recherche translationnelle (TR; recherche d'indications, développement de paramètres et de biomarqueurs) : - En collaboration avec le chef de l'AT dermatologique, les chercheurs en BR, d'autres fonctions de ligne de TM (BMD, CS&I, PCS, PKS), élaborer des stratégies pour identifier les indications initiales ou d'expansion (EIP) et obtenir des preuves suffisantes pour financer ces idées.

Développement des entreprises et délivrance de licences (BD&L; composés d'autorisation et de délivrance de licences) : - Participer aux équipes de BD&L en tant que représentant du TM.

Responsabilités générales : - Responsable de la surveillance clinique et de l'examen intégré des données sur l'innocuité pendant et après la phase de vie d'une étude. - Dirige et experte médicalement et scientifiquement toutes les fonctions de l'équipe d'étude. - Représenter les aspects cliniques de la médecine translationnelle aux autorités sanitaires et aux autres intervenants (p. ex., les années 006 et les groupes de défense des patients). - Superviser la stratégie de publication des études sur les TM; diriger la rédaction des publications scientifiques; présenter les résultats de l'étude de l'extérieur, le cas échéant.

Leadership : - Équipes et équipes d'essais cliniques qui sont chargées de diriger des études particulières en partenariat avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne. - Sous-équipes de projet mondial - Collaborez étroitement avec d'autres fonctions de la ligne TM (en particulier CS et I) et non MC (en particulier la gestion de projet) afin d'assurer l'excellence opérationnelle, l'urgence continue et une attention étroite aux délais, aux coûts et au fardeau des sujets en équilibre avec des normes scientifiques élevées et l'innovation

Exigences essentielles : - Doctorat, MD - Dermatologue certifié par le conseil - Doctorat de préférence en dermatologie/immunologie - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise pharmaceutique/biotech, un centre de recherche ou un centre médical universitaire, ou expérience connexe - Innovation : recherche de nouvelles possibilités de découverte clinique et de nouvelles approches pour atteindre le PDT - Expert reconnu en matière de recherche, qui a permis de réussir des études et des projets individuels; respecté par des collègues de R-D, de Développement et externe - Anglais oral et écrit

Avantages et récompenses Chez Novartis, nous sommes déterminés à recréer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la rendent possible.

Gamme de salaires de base annuels prévus pour le rôle : - 122 500.00 - 227 500.00 CHF Annua

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental l

Gamma di insalata: CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00 Descrizione del lavoro #LI-Hybrid # Posizione: Basilea, Svizzera o Cambridge, Stati Uniti (vedi postazione separata) Pronto a plasmare il futuro dell'innovazione a Novartis? In qualità di Procuratore di Brevetti, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella protezione delle scoperte scientifiche innovative e consentendo farmaci che cambiano la vita per raggiungere i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Collaborando a stretto contatto con i team R&D, si guidano decisioni strategiche di proprietà intellettuale, costruire portafogli di brevetti robusti e navigare paesaggi legali complessi per salvaguardare l'innovazione nel ciclo di vita del prodotto. Descrizione del lavoro Principali responsabilità
• Fornire consulenza chiara, strategica e orientata al business ai clienti R&D Novartis sulla protezione delle invenzioni, sviluppo del portafoglio, strategia di pubblicazione e rischi di terze parti.
• Costruire e gestire portafogli di brevetti per progetti R&D Novartis identificando invenzioni e preparando, perseguendo, mantenendo e difendendo i brevetti in aree come nuove entità molecolari, processi, produzione, piattaforme, tecnologie e sviluppi clinici.
• Render opinioni legali sulla brevettabilità, la validità e la libertà di operare, e sviluppare strategie di brevetti che rafforzano le posizioni IP, supportano la libertà di operare e consentono una difesa IP efficace.
• Applicare una profonda conoscenza del diritto e della pratica dei brevetti nazionali, compresi gli sviluppi legali rilevanti e le tendenze dei brevetti, per modellare la strategia e la consulenza.
• Comprendere ed applicare altre forme di protezione dell'esclusività, come opportuno.
• Comunicare efficacemente con colleghi e leader nelle organizzazioni legali, IP e R&D.
• Costruire e gestire le relazioni con i consulenti esterni e i collaboratori, tra cui una vasta interazione all'interno di una funzione multiculturale di brevetti globale.
• Condurre due diligence e fornire consulenza basata su tali valutazioni, tra cui libertà di operare, violazione, validità, valutazione del rischio e strategie di mitigazione del rischio.
• Fornire supporto IP per questioni transazionali, tra cui M&A, collaborazioni di ricerca e opportunità di in-licenziamento, con consigli sulla redazione dei contratti e la negoziazione
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva e di alta qualità del lavoro allineato con obiettivi di business e budget Requisiti essenziali
• Juris Dottore laurea con ammissione ad almeno una barra di stato, e registrazione alla pratica prima dell'Ufficio brevetti e marchi degli Stati Uniti.
• Grado avanzato in chimica o campo correlato, con forte preferenza per un grado di dottorato
• Esperienza significativa come avvocato brevetti all'interno di uno studio legale o farmaceutico o biotecnologia
• Forte competenza tecnica in chimica, preferibilmente compreso l'esperienza con piccole molecole, sintesi o sviluppo farmaceutico.
• Competenza nel diritto dei brevetti USA e PCT, nei processi di deposito e nella pratica dell'accusa, con una comprensione dettagliata del diritto europeo dei brevetti e di altri importanti sistemi di brevetti globali
• Prova capacità di collaborare con gli stakeholder scientifici e commerciali per fornire consulenza strategica sulla proprietà intellettuale

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: TA Head, PKS Immunology
Location: Basel

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary scientific leader to join us as TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In this highly visible role, you will lead a cross-functional scientific organization spanning pharmacokinetics, clinical pharmacology, bioanalysis, and quantitative pharmacology across discovery, early development, and late-stage development. You will play a critical role in advancing the immunology portfolio, shaping integrated development strategies and enabling high-quality portfolio decisions.

As TA Head, PKS Immunology, you will provide strategic and scientific leadership across a portfolio of diverse modalities with a broad translational sciences remit. You will be responsible for defining fit-for-purpose development strategies across programs, ensuring scientific rigor in execution, and building strong partnerships across research, development, regulatory, and portfolio teams. This role requires a leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. You will also lead and develop scientists and serve as an important internal and external representative of the organization.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement integrated platform and program strategies from discovery through registration

• Support data-driven decision-making and differentiated development strategies for the immunology portfolio

• Oversee pharmacokinetic, clinical pharmacology, bioanalytical and quantitative pharmacology contributions to regulatory submissions and supporting documentation

• Support health authority interactions by ensuring high-quality scientific input into development and regulatory strategies

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across discovery, development, regulatory, and other key partner functions to ensure rigorous and efficient program execution

• Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing scientific team, including oversight of PKS Immunology scientists

• Serve as a scientific thought leader internally and externally through collaborations, publications, presentations, and participation in relevant scientific forums

• Promote operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources

• Leverage digital tools, AI, and automation, where appropriate, to enhance insight generation, efficiency, and decision-making

Leadership Behaviors in Action

• Deliver results through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on value and outcomes

• Demonstrate an enterprise mindset and strong ownership by prioritizing resources and decisions for maximum portfolio and patient impact

• Role‑model leadership behaviors through visible actions, continuous self‑reflection, and openness to feedback

• Build trust through transparent communication, clear accountability, and consistent delivery against commitments

• Empower others to innovate and improve while maintaining high scientific, ethical, and operational standards

AI Fluency

• Bring strong AI and digital fluency, using enterprise tools to enhance insight generation, decision‑making, and team productivity

• Accountable for the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI in line with enterprise AI governance and data protection standards

External Eminence

• Act as an external thought leader, advancing and elevating Novartis’ reputation in translational science and innovation

Operational Excellence

• Drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources to maximize PKS and enterprise value

• Act as a responsible steward of people, data, and digital capabilities, leveraging AI and automation to improve efficiency, quality, and decision speed

• Apply value

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: Senior Principal Scientist or Associate Director
Location: Basel, Switzerland

The Modeling & Simulation group within PK Sciences is looking for a Principal Scientist to Associate Director level modeler, to develop and apply translational physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling along with data analysis techniques to facilitate drug discovery, development, and translational research across disease areas. Importantly, the candidate has experience with regulatory submissions and in successful regulatory interactions. The candidate’s core responsibilities will include PBPK modeling to integrate in vitro and in vivo data for drug-drug interaction (DDI) assessments, impact of biopharmaceutics properties on absorption, and pharmacokinetic (PK) predictions in humans as well as in specific populations (e.g. disease, organ impairment, pediatrics). The ultimate goal of this work is to be on the forefront of applying PBPK models to inform the safe administration of our drug candidates in the clinic, to optimize clinical trial designs, and waive clinical trials, ultimately, to get our medicines to patients faster.

The role requires a deep understanding of ADME/DMPK principles and biopharmaceutics knowledge, experience with industry standard PBPK modeling packages (such as GastroPlus or Simcyp) or bespoke PBPK models, regulatory submissions involving PBPK modeling, interdisciplinary thinking and great attention to detail. The applicant will work in a dynamic and multidisciplinary environment to build, verify and apply quality translational/biopharmaceutical PBPK models.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Expert PBPK modeler to provide translational modeling support for global drug discovery and development projects

• Perform translational PBPK analyses to predict clinical drug exposure in specific populations, assess potential for DDI, understand clinical impact of disease on drug exposure, as well as apply biopharmaceutic PBPK modeling to support formulation changes and achieve clinical biowaivers

• Integrate PK/ PD data, ADME and DDI findings

• Ability to interpret and communicate modeling results and potential impact to project teams

• Prepare summary documents for use in regulatory submissions and ability to respond independently to health authority questions

Essential requirements

• PhD in pharmaceutical sciences or related discipline with experience in ADME/DMPK sciences, biopharmaceutics, and modeling and simulation. At least 5+ years in pharmaceutical industry including demonstrated knowledge and experience with PBPK modeling. The level of the position would depend upon the experience of the candidate.

• Hands on experience with PBPK modeling tools such as PK-Sim, Simcyp, or GastroPlus is required. In addition, experience with modeling software such as Monolix, R, Phoenix, or Nonmem is desired.

• Experience in authoring regulatory documents, knowledge of global regulatory requirements and guidance

• Broad knowledge of drug discovery and development, e.g., pharmacokinetics, drug delivery, formulation, ADME, DDI, etc.

This is a hybrid role that requires a balance of in-person and virtual working, with an average of 12 days a month on site in Basel, Switzerland.
Candidates with demonstrated impact as a modeler, preferably in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, and with commensurate experience and proficiency may be considered for the Principal Scientist II (5+ years) or Associate Director (8+ years) role.
This is a dual posting. The final level & title of the offer role would be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience & capabilities required to perform the role at the level the role has been offered

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Titolo interno: Senior Principal Scientist o Associate Director
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

Il gruppo Modeling & Simulation all'interno di PK Sciences sta cercando un Principal Scientist to Associate Director level modeler, per sviluppare e applicare la modellazione farmacokinetic (PBPK) a base fisiologica traduttiva, insieme a tecniche di analisi dei dati per facilitare la scoperta, lo sviluppo e la ricerca traduttiva nelle aree di malattia. Importante, il candidato ha esperienza con le presentazioni normative e nelle interazioni normative di successo. Le responsabilità principali del candidato includono la modellazione PBPK per integrare i dati in vitro e in vivo per le valutazioni di interazione farmaco-droga (DDI), l'impatto delle proprietà di biofarmaci sull'assorbimento, e le previsioni farmacocinetiche (PK) negli esseri umani, così come in popolazioni specifiche (ad esempio malattia, alterazione degli organi, pediatrica). L'obiettivo finale di questo lavoro è quello di essere in prima linea nell'applicazione dei modelli PBPK per informare l'amministrazione sicura dei nostri candidati alla droga nella clinica, per ottimizzare i progetti di prova clinica, e gli studi clinici waive, in definitiva, per ottenere i nostri farmaci ai pazienti più velocemente.

Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dei principi ADME/DMPK e delle conoscenze biofarmaceutiche, esperienza con i pacchetti di modellazione PBPK standard del settore (come GastroPlus o Simcyp) o modelli PBPK su misura, presentazioni normative che coinvolgono la modellazione PBPK, pensiero interdisciplinare e grande attenzione ai dettagli. Il richiedente lavorerà in un ambiente dinamico e multidisciplinare per costruire, verificare e applicare modelli PBPK traduttivi/biofarmaceutici di qualità.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Esperto modellatore PBPK per fornire supporto di modellazione traduttiva per i progetti globali di scoperta e sviluppo della droga

• Eseguire analisi PBPK traduttive per prevedere l'esposizione di farmaci clinici in popolazioni specifiche, valutare il potenziale per DDI, comprendere l'impatto clinico della malattia sull'esposizione alla droga, nonché applicare la modellazione PBPK biofarmaceutica per supportare i cambiamenti di formulazione e raggiungere i biowaivers clinici

• Integra i dati PK/ PD, i risultati ADME e DDI

• Capacità di interpretare e comunicare i risultati della modellazione e il potenziale impatto per i team di progetto

• Preparare i documenti di sintesi per l'uso nelle presentazioni regolamentari e la capacità di rispondere indipendentemente alle domande dell'autorità sanitaria

Requisiti essenziali

• PhD in scienze farmaceutiche o disciplina correlata con esperienza in scienze ADME/DMPK, biofarmaci e modellazione e simulazione. Almeno 5 anni in industria farmaceutica, tra cui la conoscenza dimostrata e l'esperienza con la modellazione PBPK. Il livello della posizione dipenderebbe dall'esperienza del candidato.

• Le mani sull'esperienza con strumenti di modellazione PBPK come PK-Sim, Simcyp o GastroPlus sono necessarie. Inoltre, l'esperienza con software di modellazione come Monolix, R, Phoenix o Nonmem è desiderata.

• Esperienza nell'autorizzazione di documenti normativi, conoscenza dei requisiti normativi globali e della guida

• Ampia conoscenza della scoperta e dello sviluppo della droga, ad esempio, farmacocinetica, consegna della droga, formulazione, ADME, DDI, ecc.

Questo è un ruolo ibrido che richiede un equilibrio di lavoro in-persona e virtuale, con una media di 12 giorni al mese in loco a Basilea, Svizzera.
I candidati con impatto dimostrato come modellatore, preferibilmente nel settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, e con esperienza e competenza commisurata possono essere considerati per il ruolo principale scienziato II (5+ anni) o direttore associato (8+ anni).
Questa è una doppia pubblicazione. Il livello finale & titolo del ruolo di offerta sarebbe determinato dal team di assunzione basato sulle competenze, esperienze e capacità necessarie per svolgere il ruolo a livello il ruolo è stato offerto

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

#LI-Hybrid
Interner Titel: Senior Principal Scientist oder Associate Director
Standort: Basel, Schweiz

Die Modeling & Simulationsgruppe innerhalb von PK Sciences sucht einen Principal Scientist to Associate Director-Modellierer, der translationale physiologisch basierte pharmakokinetische (PBPK) Modellierung zusammen mit Datenanalysetechniken entwickelt und anwendet, um die Wirkstoffforschung, -entwicklung und translationale Forschung in Krankheitsgebieten zu erleichtern. Wichtig ist, dass der Kandidat Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Einreichungen und in erfolgreichen regulatorischen Interaktionen hat. Zu den Kernaufgaben des Kandidaten gehören die PBPK-Modellierung zur Integration von In-vitro- und In-vivo-Daten für die Beurteilung der Wechselwirkung zwischen Arzneimitteln (DDI), die Auswirkungen der biopharmazeutischen Eigenschaften auf die Absorption und die Vorhersagen der Pharmakokinetik (PK) bei Menschen sowie in bestimmten Populationen (z. B. Krankheit, Organschädigung, Kinderheilkunde). Das ultimative Ziel dieser Arbeit ist es, bei der Anwendung von PBPK-Modellen an vorderster Front zu stehen, um die sichere Verabreichung unserer Medikamentenkandidaten in der Klinik zu informieren, klinische Studiendesigns zu optimieren und auf klinische Studien zu verzichten, um letztendlich unsere Medikamente schneller zu Patienten zu bringen.

Die Rolle erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der ADME / DMPK-Prinzipien und Biopharmazeutik-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Industriestandard-PBPK-Modellierungspaketen (wie GastroPlus oder Simcyp) oder maßgeschneiderten PBPK-Modellen, regulatorische Einreichungen mit PBPK-Modellierung, interdisziplinäres Denken und viel Liebe zum Detail. Der Antragsteller wird in einem dynamischen und multidisziplinären Umfeld arbeiten, um qualitativ hochwertige translationale / biopharmazeutische PBPK-Modelle zu erstellen, zu verifizieren und anzuwenden.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Experte für PBPK-Modellierung zur Unterstützung translationaler Modellierung für globale Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte

• Führen Sie translationale PBPK-Analysen durch, um die klinische Arzneimittelexposition in bestimmten Populationen vorherzusagen, das Potenzial für DDI zu bewerten, die klinischen Auswirkungen der Krankheit auf die Arzneimittelexposition zu verstehen sowie biopharmazeutische PBPK-Modellierung anzuwenden, um Formulierungsänderungen zu unterstützen und klinische Biowaivers zu erreichen

• Integration von PK/PD-Daten, ADME- und DDI-Ergebnissen

• Fähigkeit, Modellierungsergebnisse und potenzielle Auswirkungen auf Projektteams zu interpretieren und zu kommunizieren

• Bereiten Sie zusammenfassende Dokumente für die Verwendung in regulatorischen Einreichungen und die Fähigkeit, unabhängig auf Fragen der Gesundheitsbehörde zu antworten

Grundlegende Anforderungen

• PhD in pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften oder verwandten Disziplin mit Erfahrung in ADME / DMPK Wissenschaften, Biopharmazie und Modellierung und Simulation. Mindestens 5+ Jahre in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, einschließlich nachgewiesener Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit PBPK-Modellierung. Das Niveau der Position würde von der Erfahrung des Kandidaten abhängen.

• Erfahrung mit PBPK-Modellierungstools wie PK-Sim, Simcyp oder GastroPlus ist erforderlich. Darüber hinaus ist Erfahrung mit Modellierungssoftware wie Monolix, R, Phoenix oder Nonmem erwünscht.

• Erfahrung in der Erstellung von regulatorischen Dokumenten, Kenntnis der globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen und Leitlinien

• Breites Wissen über Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung, z. B. Pharmakokinetik, Arzneimittelabgabe, Formulierung, ADME, DDI usw.

Dies ist eine hybride Rolle, die eine Balance zwischen persönlicher und virtueller Arbeit erfordert, mit durchschnittlich 12 Tagen im Monat vor Ort in Basel, Schweiz.
Kandidaten mit nachgewiesener Wirkung als Modellierer, vorzugsweise in der Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie, und mit entsprechender Erfahrung und Kompetenz können für den Principal Scientist II (5+ Jahre) oder Associate Director (8+ Jahre) Rolle in Betracht gezogen werden.
Das ist ein Dual Posting. Die endgültige Ebene und der Titel der Angebotsrolle werden vom Einstellungsteam auf der Grundlage der Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten festgelegt, die erforderlich sind, um die Rolle auf der Ebene auszuführen, auf der die Rolle angeboten wurde

Les principales responsabilités des candidats comprendront la modélisation du PBPK afin d'intégrer les données in vitro et in vivo pour les évaluations de l'interaction médicament-médicament (IDD), l'impact des propriétés biopharmaceutiques sur l'absorption et les prédictions pharmacocinétiques (PK) chez l'homme ainsi que dans certaines populations (p. ex., maladie, déficience des organes, pédiatrie). L'objectif ultime de ce travail est d'être à l'avant-garde de l'application des modèles PBPK pour informer l'administration sécuritaire de nos candidats à la médecine dans la clinique, d'optimiser les plans d'essais cliniques, et de renoncer aux essais cliniques, en fin de compte, pour obtenir nos médicaments aux patients plus rapidement.

Le rôle exige une compréhension approfondie des principes ADME/DMPK et des connaissances biopharmaceutiques, de l'expérience des ensembles de modélisation standard de la PBPK de l'industrie (comme GastroPlus ou Simcyp) ou des modèles de la PBPK sur mesure, des présentations réglementaires impliquant la modélisation de la PBPK, une réflexion interdisciplinaire et une grande attention aux détails. Le candidat travaillera dans un environnement dynamique et multidisciplinaire pour construire, vérifier et appliquer des modèles PBPK translationnels/biopharmaceutiques de qualité.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Modélisateur expert PBPK pour fournir un appui à la modélisation translationnelle pour les projets mondiaux de découverte et de développement de médicaments

• Effectuer des analyses translationnelles du PBPK pour prédire l'exposition aux médicaments cliniques dans certaines populations, évaluer le potentiel d'IDD, comprendre l'impact clinique de la maladie sur l'exposition aux médicaments, et appliquer la modélisation biopharmaceutique du PBPK pour appuyer les changements de formulation et obtenir des résultats biologiques cliniques

• Intégrer les données PK/PD, les constatations ADME et DDI

• Capacité d'interpréter et de communiquer les résultats de la modélisation et son impact potentiel aux équipes de projet

• Préparer des documents sommaires à utiliser dans les présentations réglementaires et la capacité de répondre de façon indépendante aux questions des autorités sanitaires

Exigences essentielles

• Doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques ou disciplines connexes ayant une expérience en sciences ADME/DMPK, en biopharmaceutique, en modélisation et en simulation. Au moins 5 ans et plus dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris des connaissances et une expérience démontrées en modélisation PBPK. Le niveau du poste dépendrait de l'expérience du candidat.

• L'expérience avec les outils de modélisation PBPK tels que PK-Sim, Simcyp ou GastroPlus est requise. En outre, l'expérience avec les logiciels de modélisation tels que Monolix, R, Phoenix, ou Nonmem est souhaitée.

• Expérience en matière de rédaction de documents réglementaires, de connaissance des exigences réglementaires mondiales et d'orientation

• Connaissance générale de la découverte et du développement de médicaments, p. ex. pharmacocinétique, prestation de médicaments, formulation, ADME, DDI, etc.

Il s'agit d'un rôle hybride qui nécessite un équilibre de travail en personne et virtuel, avec une moyenne de 12 jours par mois sur place à Bâle, en Suisse.
Les candidats dont l'impact a été démontré en tant que modéliste, de préférence dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique, et dont l'expérience et la compétence sont proportionnelles peuvent être considérés pour le rôle de chercheur principal II (5+ ans) ou de directeur associé (8+ ans).
C'est une double affectation. Le dernier niveau et le dernier titre du rôle d'offre seraient déterminés par l'équipe d'embauche en fonction des compétences, de l'expérience et des capacités requises pour remplir le rôle au niveau où le rôle a été offert.

Avantages et récompenses
À Novartis, nous sommes engagés à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la font arriver.

Échelle salariale annuelle de base prévue pour le rôle :

• 12

Salary Range:
CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00

Job Description Summary
LI#- Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives. As a Senior Principal Scientist / Associate Director within Molecular & Cellular Sciences (MCS), you will play a critical role in advancing exploratory biomarker strategies across our clinical pipeline. You will work at the intersection of biology, technology, and clinical development to deliver innovative biomarker solutions that enable smarter decisions and better outcomes for patients.

This is a highly visible scientific leadership position where you will influence biomarker strategies across multiple programs, collaborate with global experts, and drive the implementation of cutting-edge biomarker technologies from early development through clinical studies.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Lead a team of scientists responsible for developing, validating, and implementing exploratory soluble biomarker assays using LC-MS and immunoassay platforms across the Novartis portfolio.

• Serve as a subject matter expert in LC-MS and immunoassay technologies, such as ELISA, MSD, NULISA, and Ella.

• Oversee LC-MS and immunoassay laboratory operations, ensuring effective processes, procedures, resource planning, and project prioritization.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership to resolve analytical challenges and ensure high-quality method development, validation, sample analysis, and biomarker result delivery.

• Lead biomarker assay activities for clinical studies, including biomarker assays run internally or outsourced to strategic vendors.

• Analyze complex scientific data, interpret results, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for project teams and governance bodies.

• Identify emerging biomarkers, technologies, and methodologies that strengthen biomarker capabilities and support drug development decisions.

• Build strong collaborations across Novartis research functions and with external partners, including vendors, to advance biomarker strategy and execution.

• Represent Novartis through scientific publications, presentations, conferences, and external scientific engagement.

• Mentor, coach, and develop scientists and technical staff while fostering a culture of scientific excellence, innovation, and collaboration.

Essential Qualifications

• PhD with 5+ years or MSc with 8+ years of relevant industry experience in biomarker development, translational research, or related fields.

• Associate Director level will require previous people leadership experience.

• Strong expertise in soluble biomarker assay development, validation, and clinical implementation, including LC-MS and immunoassay platforms.

• Experience applying biomarker strategies from preclinical to clinical development to support program decisions and advance the portfolio.

• Proven scientific leadership, with the ability to shape strategy, solve technical challenges, and drive high-quality execution. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills in matrixed research, clinical, operational, and external partner environments.

• Solid experience mentoring and developing scientists or technical staff.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex science, influence stakeholders, and guide project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong track record for providing scientific contributions in biomarkers, translational science, or analytical technologies.

• Established external scientific reputation through conferences, collaborations, publications, or consortia.

This is a dual posting. The final level & title of the offer role would be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience & capabilities required to perform the role at the level the role has been offered

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

A Novartis, stiamo rivisitando la medicina per migliorare ed estendere la vita delle persone. Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Guidare un team di scienziati responsabili per lo sviluppo, la convalida e l'attuazione di saggi biomarcatori solubili esplorativi utilizzando piattaforme LC-MS e immunoassay attraverso il portafoglio Novartis.

• Servire come esperto di materia in tecnologie LC-MS e immunoassay, come ELISA, MSD, NULISA e Ella.

• Superare le operazioni di laboratorio LC-MS e immunoassay, assicurando processi efficaci, procedure, pianificazione delle risorse e priorità del progetto.

• Fornire leadership tecnica pratica per risolvere le sfide analitiche e garantire lo sviluppo di metodi di alta qualità, la validazione, l'analisi dei campioni e la consegna dei risultati del biomarcatore.

• Le attività di analisi del biomarcatore di piombo per gli studi clinici, tra cui le analisi del biomarcatore funzionano internamente o esternamente ai fornitori strategici.

• Analizzare i dati scientifici complessi, interpretare i risultati e tradurre i risultati in raccomandazioni attuabili per team di progetto e enti di governance.

• Identificare biomarcatori emergenti, tecnologie e metodologie che rafforzano le capacità di biomarcatore e supportano le decisioni di sviluppo della droga.

• Costruire forti collaborazioni tra le funzioni di ricerca Novartis e con partner esterni, inclusi i fornitori, per avanzare la strategia e l'esecuzione del biomarcatore.

• Rappresentare Novartis attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche, presentazioni, conferenze e impegno scientifico esterno.

• Mentore, allenatore, e sviluppare scienziati e personale tecnico, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza scientifica, innovazione e collaborazione.

Qualifiche essenziali

• PhD con 5+ anni o MSc con 8+ anni di esperienza del settore rilevante nello sviluppo del biomarcatore, nella ricerca traduttiva o nei campi correlati.

• Il livello di amministratore associato richiederà precedenti esperienze di leadership.

• Forte competenza nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione clinica del test biomarca solubile, comprese le piattaforme LC-MS e immunoassay.

• Esperienza nell'applicazione di strategie di biomarcatore dal preclinico allo sviluppo clinico per supportare le decisioni del programma e avanzare il portafoglio.

• Proventa leadership scientifica, con la capacità di modellare la strategia, risolvere le sfide tecniche e guidare l'esecuzione di alta qualità. Forte capacità di collaborazione interfunzionale in ambienti di ricerca matrice, clinici, operativi e partner esterni.

• Esperienza solida mentoring e sviluppo di scienziati o personale tecnico.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di spiegare la scienza complessa, influenzare gli stakeholder e guidare i team di progetto.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Forte track record per fornire contributi scientifici in biomarcatori, scienza traduttiva, o tecnologie analitiche.

• Fondata la reputazione scientifica esterna attraverso conferenze, collaborazioni, pubblicazioni o consorzi.

Questa è una doppia pubblicazione. Il livello finale & titolo del ruolo di offerta sarebbe determinato dal team di assunzione basato sulle competenze, esperienze e capacità necessarie per svolgere il ruolo a livello il ruolo è stato offerto

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Biologie, Technologie und klinischer Entwicklung, um innovative Biomarker-Lösungen zu liefern, die intelligentere Entscheidungen und bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten ermöglichen.

Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare wissenschaftliche Führungsposition, in der Sie Biomarker-Strategien über mehrere Programme hinweg beeinflussen, mit globalen Experten zusammenarbeiten und die Implementierung modernster Biomarker-Technologien von der frühen Entwicklung bis hin zu klinischen Studien vorantreiben.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie ein Team von Wissenschaftlern, die für die Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung von explorativen löslichen Biomarker-Assays mit LC-MS und Immunoassay-Plattformen im gesamten Novartis-Portfolio verantwortlich sind.

• Dienen Sie als Fachexperte für LC-MS und Immunoassay-Technologien wie ELISA, MSD, NULISA und Ella.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie den LC-MS- und Immunoassay-Laborbetrieb und gewährleisten Sie effektive Prozesse, Verfahren, Ressourcenplanung und Projektpriorisierung.

• Geben Sie praktische technische Führung, um analytische Herausforderungen zu lösen und eine qualitativ hochwertige Methodenentwicklung, Validierung, Probenanalyse und Biomarker-Ergebnislieferung sicherzustellen.

• Leitende Biomarker-Assay-Aktivitäten für klinische Studien, einschließlich Biomarker-Assays, die intern durchgeführt oder an strategische Anbieter ausgelagert werden.

• Analysieren Sie komplexe wissenschaftliche Daten, interpretieren Sie Ergebnisse und übersetzen Sie die Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für Projektteams und Leitungsgremien.

• Identifizieren Sie neue Biomarker, Technologien und Methoden, die die Biomarkerfähigkeiten stärken und Entscheidungen zur Arzneimittelentwicklung unterstützen.

• Aufbau starker Kooperationen zwischen Novartis-Forschungsfunktionen und mit externen Partnern, einschließlich Anbietern, um die Biomarker-Strategie und -Ausführung voranzutreiben.

• Repräsentieren Sie Novartis durch wissenschaftliche Publikationen, Präsentationen, Konferenzen und externes wissenschaftliches Engagement.

• Mentor, Coach und entwickeln Wissenschaftler und technisches Personal, während eine Kultur der wissenschaftlichen Exzellenz, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit zu fördern.

Grundqualifikationen

• PhD mit 5+ Jahren oder MSc mit 8+ Jahren einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung in der Biomarker-Entwicklung, translationalen Forschung oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Associate Director-Ebene erfordert vorherige Führungserfahrung.

• Starke Expertise in der Entwicklung, Validierung und klinischen Umsetzung von löslichen Biomarker-Assays, einschließlich LC-MS- und Immunoassay-Plattformen.

• Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Biomarker-Strategien von der präklinischen bis zur klinischen Entwicklung, um Programmentscheidungen zu unterstützen und das Portfolio voranzutreiben.

• Bewährte wissenschaftliche Führung, mit der Fähigkeit, Strategie zu gestalten, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und eine qualitativ hochwertige Ausführung voranzutreiben. Starke funktionsübergreifende Kollaborationsfähigkeiten in matrixförmigen Forschungs-, klinischen, operativen und externen Partnerumgebungen.

• Solide Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Entwicklung von Wissenschaftlern oder technischem Personal.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Wissenschaft zu erklären, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und Projektteams zu führen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Beiträge zu Biomarkern, translationaler Wissenschaft oder analytischen Technologien.

• Etablierte externe wissenschaftliche Reputation durch Konferenzen, Kooperationen, Publikationen oder Konsortien.

LI#- Hybride
Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

À Novartis, nous réinventons la médecine pour améliorer et étendre la vie des gens. En tant que chercheur principal principal principal et directeur associé des sciences moléculaires et cellulaires (SCM), vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans l'avancement des stratégies de biomarqueurs exploratoires dans notre pipeline clinique. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la biologie, de la technologie et du développement clinique pour offrir des solutions de biomarqueurs innovantes qui permettent des décisions plus intelligentes et de meilleurs résultats pour les patients.

Il s'agit d'une position de leadership scientifique très visible où vous influerez sur les stratégies de biomarqueur à travers plusieurs programmes, collaborerez avec des experts mondiaux et guiderez la mise en œuvre de technologies de pointe de biomarqueur, du développement précoce aux études cliniques.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger une équipe de scientifiques responsables de l'élaboration, de la validation et de la mise en oeuvre d'essais exploratoires de biomarqueurs solubles à l'aide de LC-MS et de plateformes d'essais immunologiques dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de Novartis.

• Servir d'expert en matière de LC-MS et de technologies d'essais immunologiques, comme ELISA, MSD, NULISA et Ella.

• Superviser les opérations de laboratoire de LC-MS et d'essais immunologiques, en assurant l'efficacité des processus, des procédures, de la planification des ressources et de la priorisation des projets.

• Fournir un leadership technique pratique pour résoudre les problèmes d'analyse et assurer l'élaboration de méthodes de haute qualité, la validation, l'analyse d'échantillons et la livraison des résultats du biomarqueur.

• Activités d'essai de biomarqueurs de plomb pour les études cliniques, y compris les essais de biomarqueurs exécutés en interne ou sous-traités à des fournisseurs stratégiques.

• Analyser des données scientifiques complexes, interpréter les résultats et traduire les résultats en recommandations concrètes pour les équipes de projet et les organismes de gouvernance.

• Identifier les biomarqueurs émergents, les technologies et les méthodologies qui renforcent les capacités des biomarqueurs et appuient les décisions de mise au point de médicaments.

• Bâtir de solides collaborations dans l'ensemble des fonctions de recherche de Novartis et avec des partenaires externes, y compris des fournisseurs, pour faire progresser la stratégie et l'exécution des biomarqueurs.

• Représenter Novartis au moyen de publications scientifiques, de présentations, de conférences et d'engagements scientifiques externes.

• Mentor, entraîneur et perfectionnement des scientifiques et du personnel technique tout en favorisant une culture d'excellence scientifique, d'innovation et de collaboration.

Qualifications essentielles

• PhD de 5 ans et plus ou MSc de 8 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie dans le développement de biomarqueurs, la recherche translationnelle ou des domaines connexes.

• Le niveau de directeur associé exigera une expérience préalable en leadership.

• Une solide expertise dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre clinique de tests de biomarqueurs solubles, y compris les plates-formes de LC-MS et d'essais immunologiques.

• Expérience de l'application de stratégies de biomarqueur, du développement préclinique au développement clinique, pour appuyer les décisions du programme et faire progresser le portefeuille.

• Un leadership scientifique éprouvé, capable de façonner la stratégie, de résoudre les défis techniques et de conduire une exécution de haute qualité. Fortes compétences en collaboration interfonctionnelle dans des environnements de recherche matricielle, clinique, opérationnel et externe.

• Expérience solide en mentorat et en perfectionnement des scientifiques ou du personnel technique.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer les sciences complexes, d'influencer les intervenants et de guider les équipes de projet.

Qualifications privilégiées

• Forte expérience en matière de contribution scientifique aux biomarqueurs, aux sciences de la traduction ou aux technologies d'analyse.

• Une réputation scientifique externe établie grâce à des conférences, des collaborations, des publications ou des consortiums.

#LI-Hybrid

What if your expertise could help shape critical intellectual property decisions across one of the world's leading healthcare companies? As an IP Search & Analytics Manager, you will be at the forefront of scientific and patent intelligence, transforming complex data into strategic insights that support innovation, business development, and intellectual property protection. Working closely with patent attorneys, scientists, and global business teams, you will play a key role in enabling informed decisions that help bring groundbreaking medicines to patients worldwide.

• Conduct patent and scientific literature searches to support critical intellectual property and business decisions.

• Develop innovative search strategies using advanced research methodologies and specialized patent databases.

• Deliver actionable patent analytics supporting due diligence, litigation, and freedom-to-operate assessments.

• Partner with patent attorneys, scientists, and business teams to define objectives and deliver insights.

• Translate complex technical information into clear recommendations for diverse stakeholders.

• Maintain high-quality documentation, search records, and confidentiality standards across all projects.

• Strengthen organizational expertise by sharing best practices and monitoring industry developments.

Essential Requirements

• (Prof.) Master degree (or PhD) in Biology or Biochemistry or a related scientific discipline.

• Experience in patent searching, intellectual property research, technical research, or patent analytics.

• Proficiency using patent and scientific literature databases and advanced search platforms.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and research skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively within a global environment.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or related life sciences industries is a plus

#LI-Onsite

The Oncology Data Science team in Biomedical Research at Novartis works at the intersection of oncology drug discovery, computational biology, AI/ML, and data engineering. We are seeking an enthusiastic AI/ML scientist with strong curiosity for AI-driven drug discovery to join the AI & Innovation team.
This role will apply advanced AI approaches to generate insights from complex multi-modal datasets and advance our target and biomarker discovery efforts.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Design, develop, implement and apply advanced machine learning algorithms, AI models, and platforms to enable the delivery of predictive insights from pre-clinical, clinical and real-world evidence datasets.

• Demonstrate value of innovative AI techniques in the context of drug target identification, biomolecular interaction modeling, drug development and biomarker discovery.

• Work with foundational models, including pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose, and multi-modal models to advance generative AI applications in drug discovery.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and adopt best practices for ML-ready data.

• Contribute to scientific publications and present results at internal and external scientific conferences.

Requirements:

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology or related field.

• Strong experience in one or more of the following areas: generative AI, biomedical foundation models, geometric deep learning, multi-modal learning, and large-scale knowledge graphs.

• Excellent programming skills and proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, with openness to learning new tools and technologies.

• Practical experience across ML and LLM software stack, including feature engineering, model development, deployment, and validation.

• Prior experience working with omics data and familiarity with oncology drug development.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated strong research skills, evidenced by publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences and/or leading scientific journals.

Das Oncology Data Science-Team für biomedizinische Forschung bei Novartis arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Onkologie-Drogenforschung, Computerbiologie, AI / ML und Data Engineering. Wir suchen einen begeisterten AI / ML-Wissenschaftler mit großer Neugier auf KI-gesteuerte Wirkstoffforschung, der sich dem AI & Innovation-Team anschließt.
Diese Rolle wird fortschrittliche KI-Ansätze anwenden, um Erkenntnisse aus komplexen multimodalen Datensätzen zu gewinnen und unsere Ziel- und Biomarkerforschung voranzutreiben.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Entwerfen, Entwickeln, Implementieren und Anwenden fortschrittlicher Machine-Learning-Algorithmen, KI-Modelle und Plattformen, um die Bereitstellung prädiktiver Erkenntnisse aus präklinischen, klinischen und realen Evidenzdatensätzen zu ermöglichen.

• Demonstrieren Sie den Wert innovativer KI-Techniken im Kontext der Wirkstoffzielidentifizierung, biomolekularer Interaktionsmodellierung, Wirkstoffentwicklung und Biomarkerentdeckung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit grundlegenden Modellen, einschließlich vortrainierter, selbstüberwachter, Mehrzweck- und multimodaler Modelle, um generative KI-Anwendungen in der Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben.

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Best Practices für ML-fähige Daten zu entwickeln und anzuwenden.

• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und Präsentation der Ergebnisse auf internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen.

Anforderungen:

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Informatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Computational Biology oder verwandten Bereich.

• Starke Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: generative KI, biomedizinische Grundlagenmodelle, geometrisches Deep Learning, multimodales Lernen und umfangreiche Wissensgraphen.

• Hervorragende Programmierkenntnisse und Kenntnisse in Deep-Learning-Frameworks wie PyTorch, mit Offenheit für das Erlernen neuer Tools und Technologien.

• Praktische Erfahrung im ML- und LLM-Software-Stack, einschließlich Feature Engineering, Modellentwicklung, Bereitstellung und Validierung.

• Vorherige Erfahrungen mit Omik-Daten und Vertrautheit mit der Entwicklung von Onkologie-Medikamenten.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Dateneinblicke und Empfehlungen an funktionsübergreifende Teams zu kommunizieren.

• Nachgewiesene starke Forschungskompetenzen, die durch Veröffentlichungen in hochrangigen ML/AI-Konferenzen und/oder führenden wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften belegt wurden.

À Novartis, notre but est de réimaginer la médecine pour améliorer et étendre la vie des gens. En tant que chef de file de la région de la maladie, l'immunologie, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le succès commercial de notre portefeuille d'immunologie en Europe.
Ce rôle de chef de file régional très visible se situe à l'intersection de la stratégie et de l'exécution, en veillant à ce que les priorités mondiales se traduisent par des actions efficaces au niveau des pays. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales de pays, Medical, Value & Access et d'autres intervenants interfonctionnels pour stimuler la performance, améliorer l'excellence du lancement et renforcer les capacités dans toute la région.
C'est une occasion passionnante d'aider à offrir des thérapies novatrices aux patients atteints de maladies à médiation immunitaire tout en influençant la croissance future de l'un des domaines thérapeutiques les plus stratégiques de Novartis.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de la zone de lutte contre les maladies immunitaires dans toute l'Europe, en assurant un fort alignement entre l'orientation internationale et la mise en œuvre locale.

• Diriger les performances régionales en analysant les perspectives de marché, en identifiant les possibilités de croissance et en mettant en œuvre des mesures à impact élevé sur les marchés prioritaires.

• Assurer la cohérence des stratégies de marque dans les plans d'activités nationaux, en maximisant l'orientation, l'excellence de l'exécution et les résultats mesurables.

• Établir des partenariats avec les équipes de pays pour optimiser les performances du portefeuille tout en préparant les marchés aux possibilités de croissance et aux innovations futures.

• Diriger la planification et l'exécution de l'état de préparation au lancement, en assurant la réussite des étapes préalables au lancement et après le lancement.

• Favoriser l'excellence commerciale grâce à la prise de décision axée sur les données, à l'optimisation de l'engagement des clients, à la segmentation, au ciblage et à l'efficacité omnicanale.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les fonctions d'excellence en médecine, en valeur et en accès, en réglementation et en exécution afin d'obtenir des résultats opérationnels intégrés.

• Partager les pratiques exemplaires et renforcer les capacités à travers les marchés, favoriser une culture de haute performance et renforcer l'expertise en immunologie dans toute la région.

• Influencer et harmoniser les intervenants au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe tout en favorisant la responsabilisation pour l'exécution et les résultats.

• Surveiller la dynamique concurrentielle et les tendances du marché des soins de santé pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques et renforcer la préparation au marché.

Exigences essentielles

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, en affaires, en marketing ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Expérience importante dans l'industrie pharmaceutique avec une solide expérience commerciale.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de leadership au niveau national, comme le chef du secteur thérapeutique, le chef du marketing et des ventes, le chef du portefeuille commercial ou un rôle de leadership commercial équivalent.

• Forte expérience dans l'élaboration et l'exécution de stratégies de marque qui produisent un impact opérationnel mesurable.

• Expérience de lancement de produits ou de soutien et gestion du cycle de vie dans des environnements de santé complexes.

• Capacité démontrée d'interpréter le marché, perfo

Job Description Summary
As a Cardiovascular and Metabolism (CVM) Therapeutic Area Biomarker Lead (TABL) (Director) you will lead the CVM disease area biomarker matrix team and be responsible for the development and implementation of “fit for purpose” biomarker strategies and providing an effective interface for transitioning projects from early to later stage clinical development. You will be a core member of CVM clinical project teams, engaged in Translational Data Science teams, and provide therapeutic area line function review for clinical protocols. As a TABL you will lead efforts to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic and compound biology that serves the clinical and precision medicine approaches for the multi-indication CVM portfolio that focuses on heart failure, atherosclerosis, obesity and atrial fibrillation indications.

Job Description
#LI-Hybrid
This hybrid role can be based in Cambridge US, or Basel, Switzerland.
For Switzerland posting please refer to REQ:

Key Responsibilities:
• Delivering clinical project and disease biomarker strategies and plans across the early through late phase within the Cardiovascular and Metabolism portfolio and support relevant mature assets in the late phase portfolio
• Leading a dedicated matrixed group of Subject Matter Experts and project team representatives as well as key program stakeholders, to together develop biomarkers strategies for disease and/or assets across the Research-Development-Commercial continuum
• Representing Biomarker Development on Cardiovascular and Metabolism early and late Disease Area Decision Boards to identify, develop, and drive cardiovascular and metabolic disease and compound mechanistic biology, and precision medicine approaches for the portfolio
• Leading strategic translational data working groups centered on integrating and analyzing large-scale patient muti-modal data sets (omics, imaging, digital, etc.) to identify new indications, endpoints, and responsive patient subpopulations
• Representing BMD line functions in Therapeutic Area Line Function committees for clinical protocol development and operational milestone reviews
• Leading biomarker strategies and drive plans at the clinical team level as a Biomarker Strategy Lead
• Lead and/or contribute to BMD/TM/BR wide initiatives e.g. genetics, inflammation, imaging depending on background and expertise
• Stay up to date on clinical, disease, biology and scientific literature and competitor data for their respective disease areas
• Implementing strategies in close collaboration with the BMD global organization which includes over 150 associates with expertise in all aspects of biomarker science i.e. genetics, genomics, molecular and cellular, digital devices, imaging and data sciences
• Design and present the RDC biomarker strategy for transitioning and mature assets for late phase within their key pillar and ensuring study level alignment across the portfolio segment of focus

Essential Requirements:
• MD, MD/PhD, or PhD degree required, plus additional PhD/postdoc or equivalent level research
• Deep understanding of cardiovascular and metabolic disease epidemiology with particular emphasis on Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) that can be applied to questions of diagnosis, biomarker development and treatment monitoring strongly preferred
• Scientific excellence supported by recognized high quality publications; clinical and/or biological expertise in cardiovascular and metabolic diseases (Board certified or similar level preferred) with impact in ASCVD literature
• 5 plus years of independent leadership experience and external leadership/partnership in consortia and/or health authority initiatives
• Proven success in leading and partnering in multidisciplinary matrix teams across Pharma/biotech (clinical research thru healthcare applications), academic institutions, or commercial business functions including a mature bioma
