Descrizione del lavoro
Come un Cardiovascolare e Metabolismo (CVM) Area terapeutica Biomarker Lead (TABL) (Direttore) guiderà il team di matrice di area malattia CVM e sarà responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di biomarcatore "fit for purpose" e fornire un'interfaccia efficace per la transizione di progetti da inizio a fase successiva sviluppo clinico. Sarai un membro di base dei team di progetto clinici CVM, impegnati in team di Data Science Traduzionale, e fornire una revisione della funzione di area terapeutica per i protocolli clinici. Come TABL si porterà gli sforzi per identificare, sviluppare e guidare la malattia, la biologia meccanica e composta che serve gli approcci clinici e di precisione medicina per il portafoglio CVM multi-indicazione che si concentra su insufficienza cardiaca, aterosclerosi, obesità e fibrillazione atriale indicazioni.

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Questo ruolo ibrido può essere basato a Cambridge US, o Basilea, Svizzera.
Per la Svizzera inviare si prega di fare riferimento a REQ:

Responsabilità chiave:
• Fornire strategie e piani di biomarcatore del progetto clinico e della malattia in fase avanzata all'interno del portafoglio Cardiovascolare e Metabolismo e sostenere le attività mature rilevanti nel portafoglio di fase avanzata
• Leader di un gruppo dedicato di esperti e rappresentanti del team di progetti e di esperti di Materia, nonché di attori chiave del programma, per sviluppare insieme strategie di biomarcatori per le malattie e/o le attività attraverso il continuum Ricerca-Sviluppo-Commercial
• Rappresentando Biomarker Sviluppo su Cardiovascolare e Metabolismo in anticipo e in ritardo Area Malattia Bordi di decisione per identificare, sviluppare e guidare malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche e biologia meccanica composti, e metodi di medicina di precisione per il portafoglio
• I principali gruppi di lavoro di dati traduttivi strategici incentrati sull'integrazione e l'analisi dei set di dati muti-modali dei pazienti su larga scala (omics, imaging, digital, ecc.) per identificare nuove indicazioni, endpoint e sottopopolazioni dei pazienti reattive
• Rappresentare le funzioni della linea BMD nei comitati di Therapeutic Area Line Function per lo sviluppo del protocollo clinico e le revisioni operative delle pietre miliari
• Le principali strategie di biomarcatore e piani di guida a livello di team clinico come strategia di Biomarker Lead
• Piombo e / o contribuire a BMD/TM/BR ampie iniziative come genetica, infiammazione, imaging a seconda di background e competenze
• Resta aggiornato sui dati clinici, sulle malattie, sulla biologia e sulla letteratura scientifica e sui concorrenti per le rispettive aree di malattia
• L'implementazione di strategie in stretta collaborazione con l'organizzazione globale BMD che comprende oltre 150 associati con competenze in tutti gli aspetti della scienza dei biomarcatori, cioè genetica, genomica, dispositivi molecolari e cellulari, digitali, immagini e scienze dei dati
• Progettare e presentare la strategia di biomarcatore RDC per la transizione e la maturazione dei beni per la fase tardiva all'interno del loro pilastro chiave e garantire l'allineamento del livello di studio attraverso il segmento di focus del portafoglio

Requisiti essenziali:
• MD, MD/PhD o PhD richiesto, oltre ad ulteriori ricerche di livello PhD/postdoc o equivalente
• Profonda comprensione dell'epidemiologia cardiovascolare e delle malattie metaboliche con particolare enfasi sulla malattia cardiovascolare aterosclerotica (ASCVD) che può essere applicato a domande di diagnosi, sviluppo di biomarca e monitoraggio del trattamento fortemente preferito
• Eccellenza scientifica sostenuta da pubblicazioni di alta qualità riconosciute; esperienza clinica e/o biologica in malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche (Board certificato o livello simile preferito) con impatto nella letteratura ASCVD
• 5 anni più di esperienza di leadership indipendente e leadership esterna/partnership in consorzi e/o iniziative di autorità sanitaria
• Risultato successo nella leadership e nella collaborazione in team multidisciplinari di matrice in Pharma/biotech (applicazioni cliniche per la ricerca), istituzioni accademiche o funzioni commerciali, tra cui una bioma matura

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
Als Cardiovascular and Metabolism (CVM) Therapeutic Area Biomarker Lead (TABL) (Direktor) leiten Sie das CVM Disease Area Biomarker Matrix Team und sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von "fit for purpose" -Biomarkerstrategien und bieten eine effektive Schnittstelle für den Übergang von Projekten von der frühen in die spätere klinische Entwicklung. Sie werden ein Kernmitglied der klinischen CVM-Projektteams sein, sich in Translational Data Science-Teams engagieren und eine Überprüfung der therapeutischen Bereichslinienfunktion für klinische Protokolle durchführen. Als TABL werden Sie die Bemühungen zur Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Förderung von Krankheit, mechanistischer und zusammengesetzter Biologie leiten, die den klinischen und präzisionsmedizinischen Ansätzen für das Multi-Indikations-CVM-Portfolio dienen, das sich auf Herzinsuffizienz, Atherosklerose, Fettleibigkeit und Vorhofflimmerindikationen konzentriert.

Stellenbeschreibung
#LI-Hybrid
Diese hybride Rolle kann in Cambridge USA oder Basel, Schweiz, angesiedelt sein.
Für das Posting in der Schweiz siehe REQ:

Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Bereitstellung klinischer Projekt- und Krankheits-Biomarker-Strategien und -Pläne in der frühen bis späten Phase innerhalb des kardiovaskulären und metabolischen Portfolios und Unterstützung relevanter reifer Vermögenswerte im Portfolio der späten Phase
• Leitung einer speziellen Matrix-Gruppe von Fachexperten und Vertretern des Projektteams sowie wichtigen Interessengruppen des Programms, um gemeinsam Biomarker-Strategien für Krankheiten und / oder Vermögenswerte im gesamten Forschungs-Entwicklungs-Kommerziellen Kontinuum zu entwickeln
• Vertretung der Biomarker-Entwicklung für kardiovaskuläre und metabolische Früh- und Spätkrankheitsbereiche, um kardiovaskuläre und metabolische Erkrankungen zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und voranzutreiben, sowie mechanistische Kombinationsbiologie und Präzisionsmedizinansätze für das Portfolio
• Führende Arbeitsgruppen für strategische translationale Daten konzentrierten sich auf die Integration und Analyse groß angelegter mutimodaler Patientendatensätze (Omics, Imaging, Digital usw.), um neue Indikationen, Endpunkte und ansprechende Patientensubpopulationen zu identifizieren
• Vertretung von BMD-Linienfunktionen in Therapeutic Area Line Function Committees für klinische Protokollentwicklung und operative Meilensteinüberprüfungen
• Führende Biomarker-Strategien und Fahrpläne auf klinischer Teamebene als Biomarker Strategy Lead
• Führen und / oder tragen Sie zu BMD / TM / BR-weiten Initiativen bei, z. B. Genetik, Entzündungen, Bildgebung, abhängig von Hintergrund und Fachwissen
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über klinische, Krankheits-, Biologie- und wissenschaftliche Literatur und Wettbewerbsdaten für ihre jeweiligen Krankheitsgebiete
• Umsetzung von Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen Organisation BMD, die über 150 Mitarbeiter mit Expertise in allen Aspekten der Biomarker-Wissenschaft umfasst, dh Genetik, Genomik, molekulare und zelluläre, digitale Geräte, Bildgebung und Datenwissenschaften
• Design und Präsentation der RDC-Biomarker-Strategie für den Übergang und die Fälligkeit von Assets für die Spätphase innerhalb ihrer wichtigsten Säule und Gewährleistung der Ausrichtung der Studienebene auf das gesamte Portfoliosegment des Fokus

Grundlegende Anforderungen:
• MD, MD / PhD oder PhD-Abschluss erforderlich, plus zusätzliche PhD / Postdoc oder gleichwertige Forschung
• Tiefes Verständnis der Epidemiologie kardiovaskulärer und metabolischer Erkrankungen mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf atherosklerotischer Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankung (ASCVD), die auf Fragen der Diagnose, Biomarkerentwicklung und Behandlungsüberwachung angewendet werden kann, wird stark bevorzugt
• Wissenschaftliche Exzellenz durch anerkannte hochwertige Publikationen unterstützt; klinische und / oder biologische Expertise in Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen (Board zertifiziert oder ähnliche Ebene bevorzugt) mit Auswirkungen in ASCVD Literatur
• 5 plus Jahre unabhängige Führungserfahrung und externe Führung / Partnerschaft in Konsortien und / oder Gesundheitsbehörde Initiativen
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Leitung und Partnerschaft in multidisziplinären Matrixteams in Pharma / Biotech (klinische Forschung durch Gesundheitsanwendungen), akademischen Institutionen oder kommerziellen Geschäftsfunktionen, einschließlich eines ausgereiften Biomas
descriptionByLocale.fr:

142 100 CHF - 263 900,00 CHF

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
En tant que responsable de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de biomarqueur , vous dirigerez l'équipe matricielle de biomarqueur de la maladie de CVM et serez responsable de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de biomarqueur , et fournirez une interface efficace pour la transition des projets du stade précoce au stade ultérieur du développement clinique. Vous serez un membre essentiel des équipes de projets cliniques du CVM, vous engagerez dans des équipes de sciences des données translationnelles, et fournirez un examen des fonctions thérapeutiques pour les protocoles cliniques. En tant que TABL, vous dirigerez les efforts pour identifier, développer et stimuler les maladies, la mécanique et la biologie composée qui sert les approches de médecine clinique et de précision pour le portefeuille multi-indications CVM qui se concentre sur l'insuffisance cardiaque, l'athérosclérose, l'obésité et les indications de fibrillation auriculaire.

Description de l'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Ce rôle hybride peut être basé à Cambridge US, ou Bâle, Suisse.
Pour l'affichage en Suisse, veuillez consulter le QRE:

Principales responsabilités :
• Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies et des plans de projets cliniques et de biomarqueurs de maladies au début et à la fin de la phase du portefeuille des maladies cardiovasculaires et du métabolisme et soutenir les actifs matures pertinents dans le portefeuille des maladies cardiovasculaires et du métabolisme en fin de phase
• Diriger un groupe d'experts et de représentants de l'équipe de projet matricielle, ainsi que les principaux intervenants du programme, afin d'élaborer ensemble des stratégies de biomarqueurs pour les maladies et/ou les biens dans le continuum Recherche-développement-Commerce
• Représenter le développement du biomarqueur sur les comités de décision des régions de maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques précoces et tardives afin d'identifier, de développer et de stimuler les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques et la biologie mécaniste composée, ainsi que les approches en médecine de précision pour le portefeuille
• Les principaux groupes stratégiques de travail sur les données translationnelles se sont concentrés sur l'intégration et l'analyse des ensembles de données muti-modales à grande échelle des patients (omique, imagerie, numérique, etc.) afin d'identifier de nouvelles indications, des paramètres et des sous-populations de patients réceptifs.
• Représenter les fonctions hiérarchiques de la DMO dans les comités des fonctions hiérarchiques du secteur thérapeutique pour l'élaboration des protocoles cliniques et les examens des étapes opérationnelles
• Diriger les stratégies de biomarqueur et diriger les plans au niveau de l'équipe clinique comme chef de la stratégie de biomarqueur
• Diriger et/ou contribuer à des initiatives d'envergure BMD/TM/BR, p. ex. génétique, inflammation, imagerie selon le contexte et l'expertise
• Restez à jour sur les données cliniques, les données sur les maladies, la biologie et la littérature scientifique et les données sur les concurrents pour leurs zones de maladie respectives
• Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies en étroite collaboration avec l'organisation mondiale de la BMD, qui comprend plus de 150 associés possédant une expertise dans tous les aspects de la science biomarqueur, c'est-à-dire la génétique, la génomique, les dispositifs moléculaires et cellulaires, les appareils numériques, l'imagerie et les sciences des données
• Concevoir et présenter la stratégie de biomarqueur du CDR pour la transition et la maturité des actifs pour la phase tardive de leur pilier clé et assurer l'alignement du niveau d'étude sur le segment du portefeuille

Exigences essentielles:
• M.D., M.D./Ph.D. ou doctorat requis, plus un doctorat/postdoc ou une recherche de niveau équivalent
• Compréhension approfondie de l'épidémiologie des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les maladies cardiovasculaires athérosclérotiques (AVSC) qui peuvent être appliquées aux questions de diagnostic, de développement des biomarqueurs et de surveillance du traitement fortement préférées
• excellence scientifique soutenue par des publications reconnues de haute qualité; expertise clinique et/ou biologique dans les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (niveau de préférence certifié par le Conseil ou niveau similaire) avec impact dans la littérature sur l'ASCVD
• 5 ans d'expérience en leadership indépendant et de leadership/partenariat externe dans les initiatives des consortiums et/ou des autorités sanitaires
• Succès prouvé dans la direction et le partenariat d'équipes multidisciplinaires matricielles à travers Pharma/biotech (recherche clinique par applications de soins de santé), des établissements universitaires, ou des fonctions commerciales incluant un bioma mature

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Are you ready to shape the quality strategy behind some of the world's most innovative medicines? As Global Head CQA Development Unit, you will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of clinical development, patient safety, and regulatory excellence. Leading a global team of Clinical Quality professionals, you will drive strategic quality oversight across complex development programs, enabling quality-by-design approaches that accelerate innovation while safeguarding compliance, data integrity, and patient well-being. This is a unique opportunity to influence critical business decisions, partner with senior leaders across Novartis, and help bring transformative treatments to patients worldwide.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a global team of Clinical Quality Program Leads, fostering a high-performance quality culture.

• Define and execute the quality strategy for assigned Development Units, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Provide strategic quality oversight across clinical development programs to support regulatory success and patient safety.

• Partner with senior stakeholders to identify, mitigate, and escalate quality risks across global studies.

• Champion inspection readiness and lead quality support for regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen compliance, operational excellence, and quality-by-design principles.

• Influence organizational quality mindset by embedding proactive risk management and quality governance practices.

Essential Requirements:

• Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.

• Extensive experience in clinical development, quality assurance, pharmacovigilance, or regulated healthcare environments.

• Proven leadership experience building, developing, and leading global teams within a complex matrix organization.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end clinical trial processes and global regulatory requirements for clinical research.

• Demonstrated success managing high-complexity programs and influencing senior stakeholders across functions.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive collaboration globally.

Benefits & Rewards

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Come Global Head CQA Development Unit, svolgerai un ruolo di leadership fondamentale nell'intersezione dello sviluppo clinico, della sicurezza dei pazienti e dell'eccellenza normativa. Conducendo un team globale di professionisti della qualità clinica, si guida la supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso programmi di sviluppo complessi, consentendo approcci di qualità per design che accelerano l'innovazione, salvaguardando la conformità, l'integrità dei dati e il benessere dei pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per influenzare le decisioni aziendali critiche, partner con leader senior in Novartis, e contribuire a portare trattamenti trasformativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Guidare e sviluppare un team globale di Leader del Programma di Qualità Clinica, promuovendo una cultura di qualità ad alte prestazioni.

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di qualità per le unità di sviluppo assegnate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Fornire una supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso i programmi di sviluppo clinico per supportare il successo normativo e la sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Partner con gli stakeholder senior per identificare, mitigare e aumentare i rischi di qualità negli studi globali.

• Prontezza di ispezione campione e supporto di qualità di piombo per le ispezioni di regolazione, audit e attività di bonifica.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo che rafforzino la conformità, l'eccellenza operativa e i principi di qualità-by-design.

• Influenza mentalità organizzativa di qualità incorporando pratiche proattive di gestione del rischio e di governance della qualità.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Laurea avanzata in Scienze della Vita, Medicina, Farmacia, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Ampia esperienza di sviluppo clinico, garanzia di qualità, farmacovigilanza, o ambienti sanitari regolamentati.

• Prove esperienze di leadership costruire, sviluppare e leader team globali all'interno di una complessa organizzazione matrice.

• Profonda comprensione dei processi di sperimentazione clinica end-to-end e dei requisiti normativi globali per la ricerca clinica.

• Dimostrato successo gestione di programmi ad alta complessità e influenzare gli stakeholder senior attraverso le funzioni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving con la capacità di guidare la collaborazione a livello globale.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.
Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. As Global Head CQA Development Unit, you will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of clinical development, patient safety, and regulatory excellence. En tant que chef mondial de l'unité de développement de l'AQC, vous jouerez un rôle de leadership central à l'intersection du développement clinique, de la sécurité des patients et de l'excellence réglementaire. Description de l'emploi

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie de qualité pour les unités de développement affectées, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Assurer une surveillance stratégique de la qualité dans l'ensemble des programmes de développement clinique afin d'appuyer le succès réglementaire et la sécurité des patients.

• Établir des partenariats avec des intervenants de haut niveau afin d'identifier, d'atténuer et d'accroître les risques de qualité dans toutes les études mondiales.

• Préparation des champions à l'inspection et soutien à la qualité pour les inspections réglementaires, les vérifications et les activités d'assainissement.

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui renforcent la conformité, l'excellence opérationnelle et les principes de qualité par conception.

• Influencer l'état d'esprit de la qualité organisationnelle en intégrant des pratiques proactives de gestion du risque et de gouvernance de la qualité.

Exigences essentielles:

• Diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie, médecine, pharmacie, ou une discipline scientifique connexe.

• Expérience approfondie en développement clinique, assurance de la qualité, pharmacovigilance ou environnement de santé réglementé.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de leadership : création, développement et leadership d'équipes mondiales au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe.

• Compréhension approfondie des processus d'essais cliniques de bout en bout et des exigences réglementaires mondiales pour la recherche clinique.

• Succès démontré dans la gestion des programmes à haute complexité et dans l'influence des principaux intervenants sur l'ensemble des fonctions.

• Des compétences solides en communication, négociation et résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de stimuler la collaboration à l'échelle mondiale.

Avantages et récompenses

À Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui y arrivent.

Gamme de salaire de base annuelle prévue pour le rôle : 133 700,00 - 248 300,00 CHF

Le salaire de base offert est déterminé en fonction d'objectifs non sexistes, tels que les compétences, les compétences et l'expérience pertinentes conformément à la politique d'établissement de la rémunération de Novartis et lors de son adhésion à Novartis sera examiné périodiquement.
En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime basée sur le rendement selon certains paramètres de rendement.
Les récompenses de faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà du salaire de base et des incitatifs. Nous offrons également une variété d'avantages concurrentiels en nature pour vous aider à prospérer personnellement et professionnellement, tels que les régimes d'assurance, les régimes de retraite, les ressources de bien-être et les programmes de reconnaissance mondiale. De plus, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, si possible, et un congé parental rémunéré minimum de 14 semaines.

CHF150,500.00 - CHF279,500.00

Job Description Summary
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis that collaborates across the company and beyond, focusing on powerful new technologies that have the potential to help produce therapeutic breakthroughs for patients. Translational Medicine (TM) is the clinical research arm of Novartis BR, and includes about 900 associates globally. TM plays a pivotal role in bringing innovative medicines to patients, by building on research advances to develop new therapies, and bridging drug discovery and clinical application.
The TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) is a group of physicians and clinical researchers who drive innovative science from discovery to the patient through the selection, profiling, and effective development of medicines. Translational medicine experts oversee Phase 1 and 2 clinical trials to demonstrate proof-of-mechanism and proof-of-concept (PoC) in patients, as well as support for later Phase 3 development. Translational medicine experts are key and highly visible members of global cross-functional project teams that design and implement early research and discovery projects, that then culminate in clinical PoC studies. Translational medicine experts collaborate with colleagues in biology and chemistry to identify targets in diseases with significant unmet medical needs and provide input on likely clinical development pathways. The early clinical trials led by our translational medicine experts are among the most critical steps in drug development at Novartis. After PoC and if the program proceeds to full development, the translational medicine expert continues as a key member of the full development team up to and including registration.
As a Cardiovascular Metabolism (CVM) TM Expert, you will collaborate with the CVM TM Head or other experienced TM Experts to develop high value decision-strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects and to lead global cross-functional project teams through the PoC phase and beyond.

Job Description
# LI- hybrid

TME Director Cardiovascular Metabolism

Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials research, data collection activities and clinical operations, serving a leadership role in the matrixed trial team. Establishes and approves scientific methods for design and implementation of clinical protocols, data collection systems and final reports. Support new and ongoing clinical research and clinical trials and ensure efficient and timely processing of confidentiality agreements and clinical agreements

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead global project teams through PoC phase to drive implementation of the PoC strategy; participate in project teams through program life cycle from NTRC to registration

• Responsible for clinical portions of the Integrated Development Plan (IDP) through PoC.

• Acts as medical monitor for one or more clinical studies.

• Communicate clinical team matters to project teams and relevant decision boards (such as the Disease Area Decision Board).

• Convene relevant (internal and external) leaders to consider proposed approach to PoC.

• Evaluate clinical centers and foster communication with crucial collaborating investigators.

• Oversee publication and external presentation of PoC clinical study results.

• Accountable for compound related biomarker strategies; work closely with biomarker experts in implementation.

• In collaboration with research scientists identify, develop and implement strategy for preclinical support of program related objectives; this includes assessment of medical need, proposal of clinical development pathways, and review of preclinical data for clinical implications and other relevant activities

• Participate in team presentations to Health Authorities as TM Expert

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD required with clinical subspecialty training preferred in cardiovascular

Standort: Basel

Translational Medicine Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) ist eine Gruppe von Ärzten und klinischen Forschern, die innovative Wissenschaft von der Entdeckung bis zum Patienten durch die Auswahl, Profilierung und frühe klinische Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Translational Medicine Experts (TMEs) betreuen Phase 1 First-in-Human (FiH) und Phase 2 Proof-of-Concept (PoC) und Dosisbereichsfindung (DRF) Studien zur Unterstützung der Phase 3 Entwicklung. TMEs sind wichtige und gut sichtbare Mitglieder globaler funktionsübergreifender Projektteams, die frühe Forschungs- und Entdeckungsprojekte entwerfen und umsetzen. TMEs arbeiten mit Kollegen aus Biologie und Chemie zusammen, um Ziele bei Krankheiten mit signifikanten ungedeckten medizinischen Bedürfnissen zu identifizieren und Input zu wahrscheinlichen klinischen Entwicklungspfaden zu liefern, klinische Entwicklungspläne in Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung in der Spätphase zu entwerfen, klinische Studienprotokolle zu entwerfen und als medizinische Leitfäden für diese Studien zu dienen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Führen Sie globale klinische Studienteams durch die Entwicklung von Phase 1 und 2

• Entwurf des frühen klinischen Entwicklungsplans

• Handeln Sie als medizinischer Leiter für frühe klinische Studien

• Repräsentieren Sie das Team in relevanten Entscheidungsgremien

• Servieren Sie einen primären Ansprechpartner für interne und externe wichtige Meinungsführer

• Überwachung der Veröffentlichung und internen/externen Präsentation der Ergebnisse klinischer Studien

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Biomarker-Experten bei der Umsetzung

• Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungswissenschaftlern zur Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Strategie für die präklinische Unterstützung programmbezogener Ziele

• Aktiv an Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörde teilnehmen

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

• Arzt mit Board-Zertifizierung in der Gastroenterologie oder relevante medizinische Spezialität

• Mehrjährige klinische Erfahrung bei der Behandlung von IBD-Patienten (UC und CD).

• Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und unabhängig zu arbeiten

• Fähigkeit, multidisziplinäre Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu führen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten

Erwünschte Anforderungen:

• Forschungserfahrung (z.B. Ph.D.) ist ein Plus, aber keine strenge Anforderung

• Erfahrung in der Arzneimittelentwicklung als Studienforscher oder Pharma-Erfahrung sind ein Plus, aber keine strengen Anforderungen.

• Publikationen im Bereich IBD sind ein Plus, aber keine strenge Anforderung

Les experts en médecine translationnelle supervisent les études de phase 1 sur le premier patient humain (FiH) et de phase 2 sur la preuve de concept (PoC) et sur l'intervalle de dose (DRF) à l'appui du développement de la phase 3. Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea

Portando farmaci che cambiano la vita a milioni di persone, Novartis si trova all'incrocio tra scienza medica all'avanguardia e tecnologia digitale innovativa. Come azienda globale, le risorse e le opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo sono abbondanti tra cui carriere funzionali globali e locali, una suite di apprendimento diversificata di migliaia di programmi e un mercato interno per rotazioni e lavori di progetto. Con i farmaci forti conduciamo la nostra trasformazione attuale non solo consegnerà la crescita per il nostro business, ma continuiamo a permetterci di portare rapidamente farmaci innovativi ai pazienti.

I biomarcatori sono componenti critici della ricerca traduttiva, che permettono test terapeutici e meccanici robusti di ipotesi nel primo sviluppo clinico, e come abilitatori di medicina di precisione, ad esempio, la definizione delle sottopopolazioni del paziente, la predizione delle risposte del paziente e l'uso come diagnostica.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Medicina Traduttiva, partner con altre aree Malattia, Medicina Traduttiva, Sviluppo Globale e leadership commerciale per lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie innovative, complesse, esplorative di biomarcatore, indipendenti dalla fase di programma clinico, e fornisce un'interfaccia efficace per la transizione dei progetti allo sviluppo di fase successiva. Il BMD TABH conduce e sviluppa un gruppo dedicato di project team di biomarcatori porta (BML) e area terapeutica biomarker conduce (TABL) a sviluppare e supervisionare strategie di progetto cliniche, piani e tempi

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Leader chiave per identificare, sviluppare e guidare le malattie, la biologia meccanica, la farmacologia traduttiva e gli approcci di medicina di precisione per il portafoglio di Neuroscienze e DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine), sfruttando diverse modalità di biomarcatore quali genetica, genomica, proteine, cellule, imaging, dispositivi digitali e strategie di scienza dei dati

• Decisioni strategiche e supervisione esecutiva nell'indicazione / selezione del paziente, formulazione di strategia di biomarcatore e indagini sui meccanismi di azione della droga

• Responsabile per la fornitura di progetti clinici e biologia delle malattie “fit for purpose” strategie/piani biomarcatori attraverso il portafoglio di Neuroscienze e DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine) e le principali recensioni presso le Commissioni decisionali di Area Malattia (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker and Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs and governance boards

• Leader, mentori e sviluppa un gruppo dedicato di project team di biomarcatori porta (BML) e area terapeutica biomarker conduce (TABL) a sviluppare e supervisionare strategie di progetto cliniche, piani e tempi

• Fornisce la leadership del biomarcatore della malattia di Novartis internamente ed esternamente per guidare innovative iniziative/consorzio di area della malattia a medio termine attraverso progetti di studio biomarca/clinico, endpoint, diagnostica e strategie di scoperta

• Fornisce informazioni sulla selezione ottimale di esploratori, “adatti allo scopo” e biomarcatori convalidati (tra le modalità, ad esempio genetico, genomico, solubile, cellulare, imaging, digitale) per affrontare domande di meccanismo clinico e biologico, endpoint di prova e identificare le sottopopolazioni del paziente reattivo

• Opere in stretta collaborazione con altre funzioni in Biomedical Research and Development (ad esempio TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DA e DU) per fornire competenze, ottimizzare il valore del portafoglio e la risoluzione dei problemi

• Responsabile per contributi di alta qualità e revisione dei protocolli di studio, rapporti di studio clinici, piani di sviluppo integrati e piani di farmacologia clinica

• Supporta sottomissioni/decisioni interne e regolamentari di alta qualità, ad esempio la prova del concetto/meccanismo, la selezione/escalation di dosi, la sicurezza e la differenziazione competitiva

• Partecipa alle riunioni con parti esterne, inclusi gli investigatori, gli esperti esterni e le autorità sanitarie, secondo le necessità

Requisiti essenziali:

• PhD e/o MD desiderabile con biolo ampio

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel

Bringing life-changing medicines to millions of people, Novartis sits at the intersection of cutting-edge medical science and innovative digital technology. As a global company, the resources and opportunities for growth and development are plentiful including global and local cross functional careers, a diverse learning suite of thousands of programs & an in-house marketplace for rotations & project work. With strong medicines pipeline our current transformation will not just deliver growth for our business but continue to allow us to bring innovative medicines to patients quickly.

Biomarkers are critical components of translational research, enabling robust therapeutic and mechanistic hypothesis testing in early clinical development, and as precision medicine enablers e.g. defining patient subpopulations, predicting patient responses, and use as diagnostics.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine, partners with other Disease area, Translational Medicine, Global Development, and Commercial leadership for the development and implementation of innovative, complex, exploratory biomarker strategies, independent of clinical program stage, and provides an effective interface for transitioning projects to later stage development. The BMD TABH leads and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Key leader to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic biology, translational pharmacology and precision medicine approaches for the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio, leveraging diverse biomarker modalities e.g. genetics, genomics, proteins, cells, imaging, digital devices and technology/data science strategies

• Strategic decision-making and executive oversight in indication / patient selection, biomarker strategy formulation, and investigations into drug mechanisms of action

• Responsible for delivering clinical project and disease biology “fit for purpose” biomarker strategies/plans across the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio and leading reviews at Disease Area Decision Boards (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker and Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs and governance boards

• Leads, mentors and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

• Provides Novartis disease biomarker leadership internally and externally to drive innovative mid-long term disease area initiatives/consortium across biomarker/clinical study designs, endpoints, diagnostics and discovery strategies

• Provides insight into optimal selection of exploratory, “fit for purpose” and validated biomarkers (across modalities e.g. genetic, genomic, soluble, cellular, imaging, digital) to address clinical and biological mechanism questions, trial endpoints and identify responsive patient subpopulations

• Works in close collaboration with other functions in Biomedical Research and Development (e.g. TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DAs and DUs) to provide expertise, optimize portfolio value and issue resolution

• Responsible for high-quality contributions and review of study protocols, clinical study reports, Integrated Development Plans, and Clinical Pharmacology Plans

• Supports high quality internal and regulatory submissions/decisions e.g. proof of concept/mechanism, dose selection/escalation, safety and competitive differentiation claims

• Attends meetings with external parties including investigators, outside experts, and health authorities, as needed

Essential Requirements:

• PhD and/or MD desirable with broad biolo

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
#LI-Hybrid
Standort: Basel

Mit lebensverändernden Medikamenten für Millionen von Menschen befindet sich Novartis an der Schnittstelle zwischen modernster medizinischer Wissenschaft und innovativer digitaler Technologie. Als globales Unternehmen sind die Ressourcen und Möglichkeiten für Wachstum und Entwicklung reichlich vorhanden, darunter globale und lokale funktionsübergreifende Karrieren, eine vielfältige Lernsuite mit Tausenden von Programmen und ein interner Marktplatz für Rotationen und Projektarbeit. Mit einer starken Medikamentenpipeline wird unsere derzeitige Transformation nicht nur Wachstum für unser Geschäft bringen, sondern es uns auch weiterhin ermöglichen, innovative Medikamente schnell zu Patienten zu bringen.

Biomarker sind wichtige Komponenten der translationalen Forschung und ermöglichen robuste therapeutische und mechanistische Hypothesentests in der frühen klinischen Entwicklung und als präzisionsmedizinische Enabler, z. B. die Definition von Patientensubpopulationen, die Vorhersage von Patientenreaktionen und die Verwendung als Diagnostik.
Der Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine arbeitet mit anderen Krankheitsbereichen, Translational Medicine, Global Development und Commercial Leadership für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer, komplexer, explorativer Biomarker-Strategien unabhängig von der klinischen Programmphase zusammen und bietet eine effektive Schnittstelle für den Übergang von Projekten in die spätere Entwicklungsphase. Die BMD TABH leitet und entwickelt eine spezielle Gruppe von Biomarker-Projektteamleitern (BML) und Biomarkerleitern im therapeutischen Bereich (TABL), um klinische Projektstrategien, -pläne und -zeitpläne zu entwickeln und zu überwachen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Schlüsselführer zur Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Förderung von Krankheits-, mechanistischen Biologie-, translationalen Pharmakologie- und Präzisionsmedizin-Ansätzen für das Portfolio von Neurowissenschaften und DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine), wobei verschiedene Biomarker-Modalitäten genutzt werden, z. B. Genetik, Genomik, Proteine, Zellen, Bildgebung, digitale Geräte und Technologie / Data Science-Strategien

• Strategische Entscheidungsfindung und exekutive Aufsicht in der Indikation / Patientenauswahl, Biomarker-Strategieformulierung und Untersuchungen zu Arzneimittelwirkungsmechanismen

• Verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung klinischer Projekt- und Krankheitsbiologie "fit for purpose" -Biomarkerstrategien / -pläne im gesamten Portfolio von Neuroscience und DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine) und führenden Reviews bei Disease Area Decision Boards (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker und Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs und Governance Boards

• Leitet, betreut und entwickelt eine spezielle Gruppe von Biomarker-Projektteamleitern (BML) und Biomarkerleitern im therapeutischen Bereich (TABL), um klinische Projektstrategien, -pläne und -zeitpläne zu entwickeln und zu überwachen

• Bietet Biomarker-Führung für Novartis-Krankheit intern und extern, um innovative mittellangfristige Initiativen/Konsortien für Biomarker/klinische Studien, Endpunkte, Diagnose- und Entdeckungsstrategien voranzutreiben

• Bietet Einblick in die optimale Auswahl von explorativen, "zweckgerechten" und validierten Biomarkern (über Modalitäten hinweg, z. B. genetisch, genomisch, löslich, zellular, bildgebend, digital), um klinische und biologische Mechanismusfragen, Studienendpunkte und die Identifizierung ansprechender Patientensubpopulationen anzugehen

• Arbeitet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Funktionen in der biomedizinischen Forschung und Entwicklung (z. B. TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DAs und DUs) zur Bereitstellung von Fachwissen, Optimierung des Portfoliowerts und zur Problemlösung

• Verantwortlich für hochwertige Beiträge und die Überprüfung von Studienprotokollen, klinischen Studienberichten, integrierten Entwicklungsplänen und klinischen Pharmakologieplänen

• Unterstützt qualitativ hochwertige interne und behördliche Einreichungen/Entscheidungen z.B. Proof of Concept/Mechanism, Dosisauswahl/-eskalation, Sicherheit und Wettbewerbsdifferenzierung.

• nimmt an Treffen mit externen Parteien teil, einschließlich Ermittlern, externen Experten und Gesundheitsbehörden, je nach Bedarf

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

• PhD und / oder MD wünschenswert mit breiten Biolo

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Lieu: Bâle

Apportant des médicaments qui changent la vie à des millions de personnes, Novartis se trouve à l'intersection des sciences médicales de pointe et des technologies numériques innovantes. En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, les ressources et les possibilités de croissance et de développement sont abondantes, y compris les carrières interfonctionnelles mondiales et locales, une série diversifiée de milliers de programmes et un marché interne pour les rotations et les travaux de projet. Avec de solides médicaments, notre transformation actuelle ne se contentera pas de stimuler notre activité, mais nous permettra d'apporter rapidement des médicaments innovants aux patients.

Les biomarqueurs sont des composantes essentielles de la recherche translationnelle, permettant des tests d'hypothèses thérapeutiques et mécanistes robustes au début du développement clinique, et en tant que catalyseurs de la médecine de précision, p. ex. la définition des sous-populations de patients, la prédiction des réponses des patients et leur utilisation comme diagnostic.
Le responsable du secteur thérapeutique (TABH) dans le domaine du développement des biomarqueurs (BMD) en médecine translationnelle, est partenaire d'autres secteurs de la maladie, de la médecine translationnelle, du développement mondial et du leadership commercial pour l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies novatrices, complexes et exploratoires de biomarqueurs, indépendamment de l'étape du programme clinique, et fournit une interface efficace pour la transition des projets vers l'étape de développement ultérieure. Le BMD TABH dirige et développe un groupe dédié d'équipes de projets de biomarqueurs (BML) et de biomarqueurs de zone thérapeutique (TABL) pour élaborer et superviser des stratégies, des plans et des échéanciers de projets cliniques

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Chef de file pour identifier, développer et stimuler les maladies, la biologie mécaniste, la pharmacologie translationnelle et les approches de médecine de précision pour le portefeuille des Neurosciences et DARe (Maladies du vieillissement et médecine régénératrice), en tirant parti de diverses modalités de biomarqueurs, par exemple la génétique, la génomique, les protéines, les cellules, l'imagerie, les appareils numériques et les stratégies technologiques et scientifiques en matière de données

• Prise de décisions stratégiques et supervision exécutive en matière d'indication / sélection du patient, formulation de la stratégie de biomarqueur et enquêtes sur les mécanismes d'action antidrogue

• Responsable de la réalisation de projets cliniques et de la biologie des maladies.

• Dirige, mentore et développe un groupe spécialisé de chefs de projet de biomarqueurs (BML) et de chefs de projet de biomarqueurs de domaine thérapeutique (TABL) pour élaborer et superviser des stratégies, des plans et des échéanciers de projets cliniques

• Fournit à Novartis un leadership en matière de biomarqueurs de la maladie à l'interne et à l'externe afin de stimuler des initiatives/consortiums innovateurs à moyen terme dans le domaine de la maladie à l'aide de modèles d'études biomarqueurs/cliniques, de paramètres, de diagnostics et de stratégies de découverte

• Fournit un aperçu de la sélection optimale des biomarqueurs exploratoires, adaptés à l'usage et validés (par exemple, les modalités génétiques, génomiques, solubles, cellulaires, imagerie, numériques) pour répondre aux questions sur les mécanismes cliniques et biologiques, les paramètres d'essai et identifier les sous-populations de patients sensibles

• Travaille en étroite collaboration avec d'autres fonctions dans la recherche et le développement biomédical (p. ex., TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DA et UD) pour fournir une expertise, optimiser la valeur du portefeuille et la résolution des problèmes

• Responsable des contributions de haute qualité et de l'examen des protocoles d'étude, des rapports d'étude clinique, des plans de développement intégré et des plans de pharmacologie clinique

• Soutient des présentations/décisions internes et réglementaires de haute qualité, p. ex. preuve de concept/mécanisme, sélection/escalade des doses, allégations de sécurité et de différenciation concurrentielle

• Assister à des réunions avec des parties externes, y compris des enquêteurs, des experts extérieurs et des autorités sanitaires, au besoin

Exigences essentielles:

• PhD et/ou MD souhaitable avec un biolo large

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF74,200.00 - CHF137,800.00

Job Description Summary
#LiOnSite
Location: Stein

The Junior Process Expert supports the Production Unit (PU) in all process-related matters with the objective of continuously improving existing processes, both qualitatively and quantitatively, and introducing and establishing new processes.
These activities are carried out in compliance with cGMP requirements, as well as applicable SOPs and guidelines.

Job Description
Major accountabilities:

• Supports the handling of deviations, complaints, actions, and CAPAs.

• Provides support in decision-making related to production issues.

• Assists in the creation and maintenance of manufacturing instructions, including bills of materials, process sub-steps, and process steps.

• Supports the processing of quality notifications, including external and internal complaints.

• Assists in the development of specific SOPs.

• Ensures GMP-compliant documentation.

• Consistently adheres to GSU guidelines.

• Ensures cleanliness, hygiene, and order within the work environment.

• Assists in implementing corrective measures for deviations.

• Supports process and cleaning validations and assists with qualification activities (e.g., thermal requalification).

Essential requirements:

• Degree in Scientific disciplines.

• Ability to work independently.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

• Fluent in English and German.

Desirable requirements:

• Master's Degree.

• Initial experience in a GMP manufacturing environment.

We offer a temporary contract of 12 months.

Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 74.200 - 137.800

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Accessibility and accommodation: Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

The Novartis Strategy & Growth, Therapeutic Area Strategy team for Neuroscience is seeking a new Therapeutic Area Strategy Director who will support the creation and update of a holistic TA strategy; provide early-phase commercial insights to project teams; guide TA-specific internal pipeline development and external licensing / acquisitions opportunities; and support integrated enterprise alignment across Biomedical Research (BR), Development, Strategy & Growth (S&G), and the Commercial US and International units.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Brings external benchmarking, analysis and insights, and judgement to support the TA Strategy Head in developing a holistic Novartis TA strategy that achieves sustainable growth in short, mid and long-term.

• Brings both understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and the core Therapeutic Areas (TA) and Disease area of Neuroscience to derive insightful and differentiating competitive advantages over our peers.

• Provides key commercial insights to the R&D project teams, particularly for early phase programs. To do this effectively, in-market experience in the US is critical.

• Analyses reports and publications to extract key messages, including building product forecasts.

• Highly agile having the capacity to support a number of strategic DAs within a TA and multiple programs internal and external

jobs.title: Senior Expert Engineering
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF93,800.00 - CHF174,200.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives. We discover and develop breakthrough treatments and find new ways to bring cures to as many people as possible. Without safe, easy-to-use, high-quality drug delivery devices, our patients could not get their medicines. This is where you come in - the Device Technology Solution Center is looking for a Senior Expert Engineering to lead the development of innovative drug-device combination products.

We from the Device Technology Solution Center drives the technical development of autoinjectors as well as novel drug delivery principles, e.g. on-body injectors, inhalers or radioligand therapy. We closely collaborate with project management, human factors engineers, packaging experts, analytical testing, quality assurance, production, external partners, regulatory experts and many more. The objective is to develop and/or integrate innovative drug delivery systems with drug formulation and author state-of-the-art technical documentation for health authorities and production.

Job Description
Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Provide technical leadership in cross-functional device development subteams for autoinjector and other drug-device combination product development projects

• Define design input requirements and specifications, and author, review, and approve Design History File (DHF) documentation

• Lead design verification and characterization activities to demonstrate compliance with applicable requirements, standards, and intended use

• Provide technical input to regulatory submission dossiers and support responses to health authority questions related to device design, performance, and verification activities.

• Perform technical investigations and root cause analyses, identify corrective actions, and implement robust technical solutions to prevent recurrence of product and process issues.

• Ensure development activities comply with applicable regulations, standards, and internal procedures

• Collaborate with external partners, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal manufacturing organizations to ensure successful device development and industrialization.

• Ensure documentation and materials are delivered to support clinical studies, registration, and commercial manufacturing.

• Provide scientific and technical guidance to team members, facilitate knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of engineering best practices.

Role Requirements

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline

• Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in medical device and/or combination product development

• Excellent verbal communication and technical writing skills in English are required

• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and lead technical initiatives in a matrix environment.

• Experience in design verification

• Good knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and industry standards

• Experience working with suppliers and CMOs

• Experience with Design Controls and Design History File (DHF) documentation

• Minimum 80% on site work (4 days/week)

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di salario: CHF93.800.00 - CHF174.200.00

Descrizione del Lavoro Riassunto Ubicazione: Basel, Svizzera #onsite

Scopo del ruolo: In Novartis, stiamo reimmaginando la medicina per migliorare e prolungare la vita delle persone. Scopriamo e sviluppiamo trattamenti innovativi e troviamo nuovi modi per portare cure a quante più persone possibile. Senza dispositivi di consegna di droga sicuri, facili da usare e di alta qualità, i nostri pazienti non hanno potuto ottenere i loro farmaci. Qui è dove si entra - Device Technology Solution Center è alla ricerca di un Senior Expert Engineering per guidare lo sviluppo di innovativi prodotti di combinazione di dispositivi per droga.

Noi del Device Technology Solution Center guidiamo lo sviluppo tecnico degli autoiniettori e dei nuovi principi di distribuzione della droga, ad esempio iniettori sul corpo, inalatori o radioterapia. Collaboriamo strettamente con la gestione dei progetti, ingegneri dei fattori umani, esperti di packaging, test analitici, garanzia della qualità, produzione, partner esterni, esperti di regolamentazione e molti altri. L'obiettivo è quello di sviluppare e/o integrare sistemi innovativi di consegna della droga con la formulazione di farmaci e la documentazione tecnica all'avanguardia degli autori per le autorità sanitarie e la produzione.

Descrizione del lavoro Le tue responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Fornire la leadership tecnica nello sviluppo di apparecchiature interfunzionali sottoteam per i progetti di sviluppo di prodotti combinati con dispositivi antidroga e autoiniettori

• Definire requisiti e specifiche di input di progettazione, e autore, revisione, e approvare la documentazione di Design History File (DHF)

• Attività di verifica e caratterizzazione del progetto di piombo per dimostrare la conformità ai requisiti, agli standard e all'uso previsto applicabili

• fornire contributi tecnici ai fascicoli di presentazione delle normative e fornire risposte di supporto alle domande delle autorità sanitarie relative alla progettazione, alle prestazioni e alle attività di verifica dei dispositivi.

• Eseguire indagini tecniche e analisi delle cause profonde, identificare azioni correttive e implementare soluzioni tecniche robuste per prevenire la ricorrenza di problemi di prodotto e processo.

• Garantire che le attività di sviluppo siano conformi alle normative, agli standard e alle procedure interne applicabili

• Collaborazione con partner esterni, fornitori, produttori di contratti e organizzazioni di produzione interna per garantire lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione di dispositivi di successo.

• Assicurarsi che la documentazione e i materiali siano forniti a supporto degli studi clinici, della registrazione e della produzione commerciale.

• fornire orientamenti scientifici e tecnici ai membri del gruppo, facilitare la condivisione delle conoscenze e contribuire allo sviluppo delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche.

Requisiti di ruolo

• Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Biomedica o disciplina correlata

• Esperienza significativa (tipicamente 10+ anni) nello sviluppo di dispositivi medici e/o prodotti combinati

• Ottima comunicazione verbale e capacità di scrittura tecnica in inglese sono necessarie

• Capacità dimostrativa di influenzare i team interfunzionali e di condurre iniziative tecniche in un ambiente matrice.

• Esperienza nella verifica del progetto

• Buona conoscenza delle normative applicabili sui dispositivi medici e degli standard industriali

• Esperienza di lavoro con fornitori e CMO

• Esperienza con la documentazione dei controlli di progettazione e della storia del progetto (DHF)

• Minimo 80% sul lavoro in loco (4 giorni/settimana)

Impegno alla diversità e inclusione:

La Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale e inclusivo e diversi team di rappresentanti dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci siamo impegnati a reimmaginare la medicina insieme - e a ricompensare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Gamma annuale di base prevista per il ruolo: CHF 93,800 a CHF 174,200

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi neutrali per il genere, quali competenze, competenze ed esperienza pertinenti in conformità della politica di determinazione delle retribuzioni della Novartis e una volta entrato a far parte della Novartis sarà rivisto periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, puoi essere idoneo

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF65,870.00 - CHF122,330.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel
Onsite
This role is not offering relocation. Please apply only if the location is accessible to you.
#LI-Onsite

We are working on innovative medicines to treat autoinflammatory and systemic autoimmune diseases, aiming to make a meaningful difference for patients. Here, you can apply your scientific skills and curiosity within a collaborative, interdisciplinary team, with your work helping generate important insights that lead to new, life-changing therapies.

The position in the Adaptive Immunity Lab is embedded within the Immunology Research Disease Area and will focus on translational aspects and project support for B cell-driven autoimmune diseases (e.g. systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis). The role encompasses the design and execution of preclinical in vitro and in vivo studies, including complex flow cytometry-based analyses, to advance the mechanistic understanding of immune cell engager therapies. In addition, the position will contribute to the development of translational biomarker strategies to support clinical development. To lead research activities, we are seeking a scientist with a strong background in mechanistic translational research and immunology.

If you are passionate about human disease biology and compound mode of action at the interface of preclinical and clinical research, we want you on our team.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Actively contribute to drug discovery and exploratory projects aiming at discovering new ways to modulate the immune system for the treatment of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.

• Collaborate with quantitative scientists to design hypothesis-driven experiments and integrate experimental and biomarker data into models of autoimmune disease biology and therapeutic response.

• Design and conduct mechanistic experiments hands-on, utilizing human biosamples (such as blood/serum, PBMC, tissue biopsies) to generate translational data that inform project decisions, validate innovative concepts, elucidate mechanisms of action, and develop biomarker strategies.

• Plan and implement in vitro and ex vivo assays - including complex flow cytometry, cellular profiling, mechanistic cellular analyses, and examination of ex vivo samples derived from in vivo studies.

• Perform thorough analysis and interpretation of experimental results, critically evaluating whether hypotheses have been adequately tested, resolving any technical challenges, and determining subsequent experimental steps.

• Drive the development of novel hypotheses by integrating both internal and external scientific insights, proactively address research obstacles, and design strategic approaches to test these initial hypotheses.

• Work collaboratively as an integral part of cross-functional project teams, provide organized experiment record tracking and data analysis and be an active member of lab and project teams.

• Independently search for information in scientific and technical literature, establish new technologies in the lab and present your data within the team.

• Drive a culture of collaboration, talent development and integrity.

Minimum Requirements

• MSc degree in Immunology, Biology, Molecular Medicine or a related field.

• At least 3 years of relevant research expertise in an interdisciplinary setting in academia or industry, bridging clinical and preclinical evidence

• Hands-on mastery of routine immunological/ cell biology/ molecular biology assays and in vitro human models relevant to autoinflammatory and systemic autoimmune diseases (such as primary cells, cell lines, flow cytometry, qPCR etc.)

• Experienced in collaboration with data scientists, ensuring high quality experimental design and reproducibility.

• Proven track record of completing projects on schedule in view of narrow timelines

• Strong interest in working in a creative environment where you demonstrate proactiveness, a f

Descrizione del lavoro
Ubicazione: Basilea
In loco
Questo ruolo non offre trasferimento. Si prega di applicare solo se la posizione è accessibile a voi.
#LI-Onsite

Stiamo lavorando su farmaci innovativi per trattare malattie autoinfiammatorie e sistemiche autoimmuni, mirando a fare una differenza significativa per i pazienti. Qui, puoi applicare le tue competenze scientifiche e la tua curiosità all'interno di un team collaborativo e interdisciplinare, con il tuo lavoro che aiuta a generare importanti intuizioni che portano a nuove terapie che cambiano la vita.

La posizione nell'Adaptive Immunity Lab è incorporata all'interno dell'Area Malattia di Ricerca di Immunologia e si concentrerà sugli aspetti traduttivi e sul supporto di progetto per le malattie autoimmuni B (ad esempio lupus eritematoso sistemico, artrite reumatoide). Il ruolo comprende la progettazione e l'esecuzione di studi preclinici in vitro e in vivo, tra cui complesse analisi a base di citometria di flusso, per avanzare la comprensione meccanicistica delle terapie di intercettore delle cellule immunitarie. Inoltre, la posizione contribuirà allo sviluppo di strategie di biomarcazione traduttiva per sostenere lo sviluppo clinico. Per condurre attività di ricerca, stiamo cercando uno scienziato con un forte background nella ricerca traduttiva meccanica e immunologia.

Se siete appassionati di biologia della malattia umana e modalità di azione composta all'interfaccia di ricerca preclinica e clinica, vi vogliamo nel nostro team.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Contribuire attivamente alla scoperta e ai progetti esplorativi della droga per scoprire nuovi modi per modulare il sistema immunitario per il trattamento delle malattie infiammatorie e autoimmuni.

• Collabora con scienziati quantitativi per progettare esperimenti basati su ipotesi e integrare dati sperimentali e biomarcatori in modelli di biologia delle malattie autoimmuni e risposta terapeutica.

• Progettare e condurre esperimenti meccanicistici hands-on, utilizzando biosamples umani (come sangue / siero, PBMC, biopsie dei tessuti) per generare dati traduttivi che informano le decisioni del progetto, convalidare concetti innovativi, elucidare meccanismi di azione e sviluppare strategie di biomarcatore.

• Pianificare e implementare saggi in vitro ed ex vivo - tra cui citometria di flusso complessa, profilazione cellulare, analisi cellulari meccanicistiche, e l'esame di campioni ex vivo derivati da studi in vivo.

• Eseguire un'analisi approfondita e l'interpretazione dei risultati sperimentali, valutando criticamente se le ipotesi sono state adeguatamente testate, risolvendo eventuali sfide tecniche e determinando le successive fasi sperimentali.

• Guidare lo sviluppo di nuove ipotesi integrando intuizioni scientifiche interne ed esterne, affrontare proattivamente gli ostacoli di ricerca e progettare approcci strategici per testare queste ipotesi iniziali.

• Lavorare in modo collaborativo come parte integrante dei team di progetto interfunzionali, fornire monitoraggio dei record di esperimenti organizzati e analisi dei dati ed essere un membro attivo dei team di laboratorio e di progetto.

• Ricerca indipendente di informazioni nella letteratura scientifica e tecnica, stabilire nuove tecnologie in laboratorio e presentare i tuoi dati all'interno del team.

• Guidare una cultura di collaborazione, sviluppo del talento e integrità.

Requisiti minimi

• Laurea in Immunologia, Biologia, Medicina Molecolare o un campo correlato.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza di ricerca rilevante in un contesto interdisciplinare nell'accademia o nell'industria, corrodendo prove cliniche e precliniche

• Hands-on mastery di routine immunologico / biologia cellulare / analisi di biologia molecolare e in vitro modelli umani rilevanti per le malattie autoimmuni autoinfiammatorie e sistemiche (come le cellule primarie, le linee cellulari, la citometria di flusso, qPCR ecc.)

• Esperienza in collaborazione con gli scienziati dei dati, garantendo un design sperimentale e una riproducibilità di alta qualità.

• Provato record di completamento dei progetti in programma in vista di tempi ristretti

• Forte interesse a lavorare in un ambiente creativo in cui si dimostra proattività, f

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Lieu: Bâle
Sur place
Ce rôle n'offre pas de réinstallation. Veuillez n'appliquer que si l'emplacement est accessible à vous.
Sur place

Nous travaillons sur des médicaments innovants pour traiter les maladies auto-inflammatoires et auto-immunes systémiques, visant à faire une différence significative pour les patients. Ici, vous pouvez appliquer vos compétences scientifiques et votre curiosité au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire et collaborative, en aidant à générer des idées importantes qui mènent à de nouvelles thérapies qui changent la vie.

La position du laboratoire d'immunité adaptative est intégrée dans la zone de recherche sur les maladies immunitaires et sera axée sur les aspects translationnels et le soutien de projets pour les maladies auto-immunes à cellules B (par exemple lupus érythémateux systémique, polyarthrite rhumatoïde). Ce rôle englobe la conception et l'exécution d'études précliniques in vitro et in vivo, y compris des analyses complexes fondées sur la cytométrie en flux, afin de faire progresser la compréhension mécaniste des thérapies d'engagement des cellules immunitaires. De plus, le poste contribuera à l'élaboration de stratégies de biomarqueur translationnel pour appuyer le développement clinique. Pour mener des activités de recherche, nous recherchons un scientifique ayant une solide expérience en recherche translationnelle mécaniste et en immunologie.

Si vous êtes passionné par la biologie des maladies humaines et le mode d'action composé à l'interface de la recherche préclinique et clinique, nous vous voulons dans notre équipe.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Contribuer activement à la découverte de médicaments et à des projets exploratoires visant à découvrir de nouvelles façons de moduler le système immunitaire pour le traitement des maladies inflammatoires et auto-immunes.

• Collaborer avec des scientifiques quantitatifs pour concevoir des expériences fondées sur des hypothèses et intégrer les données expérimentales et biomarqueurs dans des modèles de biologie des maladies auto-immunes et de réponse thérapeutique.

• Concevoir et mener des expériences mécanistes en utilisant des bioéchantillons humains (comme le sang/sérum, le PBMC, les biopsies tissulaires) pour générer des données translationnelles qui éclairent les décisions du projet, valider des concepts novateurs, élucider des mécanismes d'action et élaborer des stratégies de biomarqueur.

• Planifier et mettre en oeuvre des essais in vitro et ex vivo - y compris la cytométrie en flux complexe, le profilage cellulaire, les analyses cellulaires mécanistes et l'examen d'échantillons ex vivo provenant d'études in vivo.

• Effectuer une analyse et une interprétation approfondies des résultats expérimentaux, évaluer de façon critique si les hypothèses ont été adéquatement testées, résoudre les problèmes techniques et déterminer les étapes expérimentales subséquentes.

• Conduire l'élaboration de nouvelles hypothèses en intégrant les connaissances scientifiques internes et externes, en s'attaquant de façon proactive aux obstacles à la recherche et en concevant des approches stratégiques pour tester ces hypothèses initiales.

• Travailler en collaboration en tant que partie intégrante d'équipes de projet interfonctionnelles, fournir un suivi des dossiers d'expérience et l'analyse des données et être un membre actif des équipes de laboratoire et de projet.

• Recherche indépendante d'information dans la littérature scientifique et technique, mise en place de nouvelles technologies dans le laboratoire et présentation de vos données au sein de l'équipe.

• Favoriser une culture de collaboration, de développement des talents et d'intégrité.

Exigences minimales

• Maîtrise en immunologie, biologie, médecine moléculaire ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins 3 années d'expertise en recherche pertinente dans un milieu interdisciplinaire dans les universités ou l'industrie, permettant de combler les preuves cliniques et précliniques

• Maîtrise manuelle des tests immunologiques/biologiques cellulaires/biologiques moléculaires de routine et des modèles humains in vitro pertinents pour les maladies auto-inflammatoires et systémiques auto-immunes (tels que les cellules primaires, les lignées cellulaires, la cytométrie en flux, le qPCR, etc.)

• Expérience en collaboration avec des data savants, assurant une conception expérimentale et une reproductibilité de haute qualité.

• Expérience prouvée de l'achèvement des projets dans les délais prévus, compte tenu des échéanciers serrés

• Un grand intérêt à travailler dans un environnement créatif où vous démontrez votre proactivité,

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Are you ready to help shape how a leading global healthcare company partners, innovates, and delivers impact? As Legal Counsel Global Procurement, DD&IT, you will play a critical role in enabling strategic business decisions, advising on high-value commercial transactions, and helping teams navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of law, technology, procurement, and innovation while collaborating with stakeholders across the globe. Your primary focus will be supporting global Procurement activities, particularly indirect procurement, while partnering with DD&IT stakeholders on technology-related matters where required.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with global Procurement teams as a trusted legal advisor on strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements for goods and services including technology, SaaS, AI and other digital solutions where required.

• Provide practical, risk-based legal guidance on commercial, operational, and governance matters.

• Support global projects and transactions while balancing legal risks with business objectives working independently and in collaboration with legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

• Deliver legal training and awareness sessions to Procurement and digital stakeholders.

• Identify, assess, and manage legal risks across procurement activities and technology-related projects . Assist in the management of disputes, dispute resolution matters and external counsel where appropriate.

• Collaborate across legal, compliance, and business teams to drive successful outcomes including supporting colleagues on cross-border matters requiring Swiss law expertise.

• Contribute to innovation, continuous improvement, and adoption of new legal technologies.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Swiss lawyer with admission to the Swiss Bar.

• Post-qualification legal experience in a leading law firm or in an in-house role

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts combined with a pragmatic, and strong solution-oriented approach .

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Proven ability to provide practical, solution-focused legal advice in complex business environments.

• Experience advising on topics like SaaS, IT and artificial intelligence

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 126.000 - 234.000 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
