Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Are you ready to help shape how a leading global healthcare company partners, innovates, and delivers impact? As Legal Counsel Global Procurement, DD&IT, you will play a critical role in enabling strategic business decisions, advising on high-value commercial transactions, and helping teams navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of law, technology, procurement, and innovation while collaborating with stakeholders across the globe. Your primary focus will be supporting global Procurement activities, particularly indirect procurement, while partnering with DD&IT stakeholders on technology-related matters where required.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with global Procurement teams as a trusted legal advisor on strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements for goods and services including technology, SaaS, AI and other digital solutions where required.

• Provide practical, risk-based legal guidance on commercial, operational, and governance matters.

• Support global projects and transactions while balancing legal risks with business objectives working independently and in collaboration with legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

• Deliver legal training and awareness sessions to Procurement and digital stakeholders.

• Identify, assess, and manage legal risks across procurement activities and technology-related projects . Assist in the management of disputes, dispute resolution matters and external counsel where appropriate.

• Collaborate across legal, compliance, and business teams to drive successful outcomes including supporting colleagues on cross-border matters requiring Swiss law expertise.

• Contribute to innovation, continuous improvement, and adoption of new legal technologies.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Swiss lawyer with admission to the Swiss Bar.

• Post-qualification legal experience in a leading law firm or in an in-house role

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts combined with a pragmatic, and strong solution-oriented approach .

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Proven ability to provide practical, solution-focused legal advice in complex business environments.

• Experience advising on topics like SaaS, IT and artificial intelligence

Ihr Hauptaugenmerk liegt auf der Unterstützung globaler Beschaffungsaktivitäten, insbesondere der indirekten Beschaffung, während Sie bei Bedarf mit DD & IT-Stakeholdern in technologiebezogenen Fragen zusammenarbeiten.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Partnerschaft mit globalen Beschaffungsteams als vertrauenswürdiger Rechtsberater für strategische Beschaffungsinitiativen.

• Entwurf, Überprüfung und Verhandlung komplexer Geschäftsvereinbarungen für Waren und Dienstleistungen, einschließlich Technologie, SaaS, KI und anderer digitaler Lösungen, sofern erforderlich.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Rechts-, Compliance- und Geschäftsteams, um erfolgreiche Ergebnisse zu erzielen, einschließlich der Unterstützung von Kollegen in grenzüberschreitenden Angelegenheiten, die Schweizer Rechtsexpertise erfordern.

• Qualifizierter Schweizer Rechtsanwalt mit Zulassung zur Schweizer Rechtsanwaltskammer.

• Nachqualifikation juristische Erfahrung in einer führenden Anwaltskanzlei oder in einer internen Funktion

• Starke Erfahrung bei der Erstellung, Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Handelsverträgen, kombiniert mit einem pragmatischen und starken lösungsorientierten Ansatz.

• Ausgezeichnete englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, praktische, lösungsorientierte Rechtsberatung in komplexen Geschäftsumgebungen anzubieten.

• Erfahrung in der Beratung zu Themen wie SaaS, IT und Künstliche Intelligenz

Principales responsabilités

• S'associer aux équipes mondiales d'approvisionnement en tant que conseiller juridique de confiance pour les initiatives stratégiques d'approvisionnement.

• Collaborer avec les équipes juridiques, de conformité et d'affaires pour obtenir des résultats positifs, y compris soutenir les collègues sur les questions transfrontalières exigeant une expertise en droit suisse.

• Contribuer à l'innovation, à l'amélioration continue et à l'adoption de nouvelles technologies juridiques.

Exigences essentielles

• Avocat suisse qualifié avec admission au Barreau suisse.

• Expérience juridique après qualification dans un cabinet d'avocats de premier plan ou dans un rôle interne

• Forte expérience de la rédaction, de l'examen et de la négociation de contrats commerciaux combinés à une approche pragmatique et fortement axée sur la solution.

• Excellentes compétences de communication anglaise, à la fois écrite et parlée.

• Capacité éprouvée de fournir des conseils juridiques pratiques et axés sur les solutions dans des environnements d'affaires complexes.

• Expérience en conseil sur des sujets comme SaaS, IT et intelligence artificielle

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF65,870.00 - CHF122,330.00

Job Description Summary
Die Stelle unterstützt die Herstellung von Wirkstoffen und festen Darreichungsformen für klinische Studien in Novartis TRD PHAD ORAL Supply Are you passionate about bringing innovative medicines to patients worldwide? As an Associate Expert Drug Supply, you will play a critical role in the manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients and solid dosage forms that support cutting-edge clinical trials. Joining our TRD PHAD Oral Supply team, you will work in a highly collaborative and quality-focused environment where your expertise directly contributes to the development of new treatments and helps transform patients’ lives.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Manufacture solid dosage forms in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice standards.

• Sieving and milling of active pharmaceutical ingredients

• Perform in-process (IPC) and process flow controls (PAK), ensuring accurate documentation within manufacturing execution systems.

• Execute encapsulation, tableting, granulation, and precise drug processing (PDP) activities according to approved procedures.

• Operate, set up, clean, and disinfect manufacturing equipment and production areas.

• Support equipment maintenance, calibration, qualification, and commissioning activities.

• Contribute to audit readiness, continuous improvement initiatives, and key performance indicator achievement.

• Collaboration in the creation / revision of procedural documents (SOP, WP, FRM).

• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, data integrity, and information security requirements.

Essential Requirements

• Completed vocational training in a technical, pharmaceutical, chemical, food production, or related field.

• Fluent German language skills, both written and spoken.

• Good English language skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience working within a Good Manufacturing Practice regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience operating manufacturing equipment and following documented procedures.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including active ingredients or solid dosage forms.

• Strong commitment to quality, safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
Desirable Requirements

• Experience within pharmaceutical or chemical development manufacturing environments.

• Forklift license or certification.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 65,870.00 - 94,100.00 - 122,330.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Die Stelle unterstützt die Herstellung von Wirkstoffen und festen Darreichungsformen für klinische Studien in Novartis TRD PHAD ORAL Supply Team. Speziell beziehen sich die Tätigkeiten auf die GMP-gerechte Produktion von Wirkstoffen und fester Darreichungsformen, Bedienung der Herstellanlagen, Unterstützung bei Wartung & Qualifizierung, sowie Reinigung und Dokumentation der durchgeführten Aktivitäten

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

• GMP-gerechte Herstellung von fester Darreichungsformen, inklusive Precise Drug Processing (PDP), Kapsulierung, Tablettierung und/oder Granulierung sowie Durchführung der In-Prozesskontrollen (IPC) oder Prozessablaufkontrollen (PAK) und Eingabe in das MES-System

• Mischen, Sieben und Mahlen von Wirkstoffen

• Bedien

• Experience working within a Good Manufacturing Practice regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience operating manufacturing equipment and following documented procedures.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including active ingredients or solid dosage forms.

• Strong commitment to quality, safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
Desirable Requirements

• Experience within pharmaceutical or chemical development manufacturing environments.

• Forklift license or certification.

jobs.title: Launch Excellence Director
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00

Job Description Summary
At Novartis, we are committed to delivering transformational medicines to patients around the world. As the Launch Excellence Director, you will play a critical role in ensuring our priority Immunology and Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolic (CRM) assets achieve successful, consistent, and impactful launches across International markets.
In this strategic role, you will serve as the dedicated Launch Excellence partner to cross-functional asset teams, driving adoption of Novartis' Launch Excellence Framework, Launch Readiness Reviews (LRRs), One Brand Plan (OneBP) governance, and pre-launch readiness indicators. Your leadership will strengthen launch strategies, improve execution readiness, enhance organizational capability, and accelerate learning across markets.
You will collaborate closely with Commercial, Medical, Value & Access, Patient Advocacy, and Regional teams to ensure launch excellence becomes a competitive advantage and delivers meaningful value for patients and healthcare systems.

Job Description
International | Immunology & Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolic (CRM)

About the Role
At Novartis, we are committed to delivering transformational medicines to patients around the world. As the Launch Excellence Director, you will play a critical role in ensuring our priority Immunology and Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolic (CRM) assets achieve successful, consistent, and impactful launches across International markets.
In this strategic role, you will serve as the dedicated Launch Excellence partner to cross-functional asset teams, driving adoption of Novartis' Launch Excellence Framework, Launch Readiness Reviews (LRRs), One Brand Plan (OneBP) governance, and pre-launch readiness indicators. Your leadership will strengthen launch strategies, improve execution readiness, enhance organizational capability, and accelerate learning across markets.
You will collaborate closely with Commercial, Medical, Value & Access, Patient Advocacy, and Regional teams to ensure launch excellence becomes a competitive advantage and delivers meaningful value for patients and healthcare systems.

Key Responsibilities
Drive Launch Strategy Excellence

• Serve as the strategic Launch Excellence partner for priority Immunology and CRM assets across the portfolio.

• Provide an enterprise-wide and cross-market perspective to strengthen launch planning and execution.

• Translate asset strategies into clear launch roadmaps, milestones, key deliverables, and critical decision points.

• Identify risks, dependencies, and execution challenges early, ensuring proactive mitigation plans.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment and coordinated launch execution.

• Incorporate customer insights, market intelligence, and best practices into launch strategies and planning.

Lead Launch Governance and Readiness

• Drive disciplined implementation of the International Launch Excellence Framework across priority assets and markets.

• Plan, facilitate, and optimize Launch Readiness Reviews (LRRs), ensuring high-quality discussions, decision-making, and follow-up actions.

• Guide teams in the effective application of pre-launch readiness indicators and performance measures.

• Analyze readiness data to identify gaps and recommend corrective actions.

• Ensure consistent governance while tailoring support to asset complexity, lifecycle stage, and market needs.

• Monitor launch milestones, deliverables, timelines, and overall readiness to maintain momentum and accountability.

Strengthen One Brand Plan Excellence

• Drive adoption and governance of the One Brand Plan (OneBP) framework across priority brands.

• Support teams in creating a clear strategic narrative connecting business strategy, tactical execution, and launch objectives.

• Facilitate high-quality OneBP reviews and leadership sign-off processes.

• Coach teams on strategic storytelling, presentatio

jobs.title: QC Analyst I
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF53,550.00 - CHF99,450.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Onsite
Ort: Stein, Switzerland

This role is based in Stein, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Welcome to where we thrive together!

Are you ready to join a community where you can make a real impact on the world through your exceptional communication skills? At Novartis, we believe in creating a positive and inclusive work environment where we can solve the toughest healthcare challenges together.

As a Quality Analyst l execution of assigned tasks in the quality control laboratory in accordance with cGxp regulations. Performance of laboratory specific activities such as analyses, maintenance, calibration and qualification of analytical equipment.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Perform analytical testing of API, drug substance, drug product, finished product, packaging material, complaint, and stability samples.

• Manage sample receipt, storage, tracking, and documentation.

• Ensure all laboratory activities are conducted in compliance with cGxP/GMP requirements and data integrity standards.

• Execute laboratory activities including analysis, equipment maintenance, calibration, and qualification.

• Support stability testing and stability sample management.

• Maintain accurate analytical documentation and records.

• Participate in inspections and maintain audit readiness.

• Identify and report HSE risks, incidents, and improvement opportunities.

• Complete required training and adhere to all HSE and GMP procedures.

• Contribute to continuous improvement and laboratory process optimization.
Essential requirements:

• Degree, apprenticeship, or equivalent qualification in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.

• Initial experience working in a laboratory environment, preferably within a GMP-regulated industry.

• Basic understanding of cGxP/GMP requirements and data integrity principles.

• Experience with analytical testing and accurate documentation of laboratory activities.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and compliance standards.

• Ability to follow SOPs and work effectively in a regulated environment.

• Good communication skills and ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams.

Desirables requirements:

• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.

• Knowledge of stability testing, aseptic techniques, or laboratory equipment calibration and qualification.

Shift Work: Code 50

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 65,870.00 - 122,330.00 CHF Annual.

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective

In qualità di Solution Architect in Innovation & Delivery, sei responsabile non solo della progettazione e della pianificazione, ma anche della gestione attiva di architetture di soluzione end-to-end che consentono sistemi digitali scalabili, integrati e ad alto impatto che supportano la ricerca biomedica. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: Yes

Ready to transform patient access to innovative immunology therapies on a global scale?

As the Director, International Value & Access, Immunology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering integrated market access strategies that maximize the value of our immunology portfolio across the research, development, and commercialization continuum. Working closely with International Therapeutic Area teams, Medical Affairs, Development, Biomedical Research, Pricing, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, and Commercial colleagues, you will help translate scientific innovation into compelling payer value propositions that enable broad, sustainable patient access worldwide. Reporting to the Head Access Immunology International, you will drive access excellence across priority markets, influence global pricing and reimbursement strategies, and develop innovative access solutions that strengthen healthcare system value while advancing Novartis' mission to reimagine medicine.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and operationalize integrated international access strategies for Immunology assets across the product lifecycle.
• Shape compelling payer value propositions and evidence packages addressing priority market and healthcare system needs.
• Embed payer evidence requirements into target product profiles, clinical programs, and integrated evidence plans.
• Create international pricing strategies and guidance that maximize sustainable patient access and long-term asset value.
• Develop payer negotiation strategies and equip priority markets for successful reimbursement discussions.
• Partner with Health Economics and Outcomes Research teams to deliver high-quality, access-relevant evidence.
• Anticipate policy, payer, and health technology assessment trends to identify access risks and opportunities.
• Collaborate across Medical Affairs, Development, Commercial, Pricing, and country teams to advance access priorities.
• Represent International Value & Access in internal governance forums and relevant external stakeholder engagements.
• Manage resources and budgets effectively, aligning investment with Immunology asset and disease-area priorities.

Essential Requirements:
• Bachelor’s, Master’s, Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), Medical Doctor (MD), or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Health Economics, Healthcare, Business, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 8 years of experience in Market Access within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Proven experience supporting and executing successful product launch strategies in international or regional markets.
• Demonstrated ability to navigate complex matrix organizations and influence diverse cross-functional stakeholder groups.
• Global or ex-US regional Market Access experience with demonstrated success in complex international environments.
• Experience developing payer value propositions, access evidence strategies, and reimbursement approaches for innovative therapies.
• Proven expertise in Market Access, Pricing, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, or related strategic access disciplines.
• Proficient English language skills, both written and spoken.

Desirable Requirements:
• Experience in Immunology, including a strong understanding of the immunology treatment landscape, payer environment, and market access challenges.

Bereit, den Zugang der Patienten zu innovativen Immunologie-Therapien auf globaler Ebene zu verändern?

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Teams des International Therapeutic Area, Medical Affairs, Development, Biomedical Research, Pricing, Health Economics und Outcomes Research sowie kaufmännischen Kollegen werden Sie dazu beitragen, wissenschaftliche Innovationen in überzeugende Wertversprechen für Kostenträger umzusetzen, die einen breiten, nachhaltigen Patientenzugang weltweit ermöglichen. Berichterstattung an den Head Access Immunology International, werden Sie den Zugang Exzellenz über prioritäre Märkte zu fahren, beeinflussen globale Preis- und Erstattungsstrategien und entwickeln innovative Zugangslösungen, die Gesundheitssystem Wert zu stärken, während Novartis Mission zur Neugestaltung der Medizin voranzutreiben.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Entwicklung und Operationalisierung integrierter internationaler Zugangsstrategien für immunologische Assets über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg.

Résumé de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid

Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

Soutien à la réinstallation : Oui

Prêt à transformer l'accès des patients aux immunologies innovantes à l'échelle mondiale?

En tant que directeur, Valeur et accès internationaux, Immunologie, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élaboration et la prestation de stratégies intégrées d'accès aux marchés qui maximisent la valeur de notre portefeuille d'immunologie dans le continuum de recherche, de développement et de commercialisation. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de la région thérapeutique internationale, des affaires médicales, du développement, de la recherche biomédicale, de la tarification, de l'économie de la santé et des résultats de la recherche, et des collègues commerciaux, vous aiderez à traduire l'innovation scientifique en propositions de valeur payante convaincantes qui permettent un accès large et durable aux patients dans le monde entier. Sous l'égide de Head Access Immunology International, vous favoriserez l'excellence de l'accès sur les marchés prioritaires, influerez sur les stratégies mondiales de tarification et de remboursement, et développerez des solutions d'accès innovantes qui renforcent la valeur du système de santé tout en faisant progresser la mission de Novartis de réimaginer la médecine.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies intégrées d'accès international aux actifs immunologiques tout au long du cycle de vie des produits.
• Former des propositions de valeur payante convaincantes et des ensembles de données probantes répondant aux besoins prioritaires du marché et du système de santé.
• Intégrer les exigences en matière de données probantes des payeurs dans les profils de produits cibles, les programmes cliniques et les plans intégrés de données probantes.
• Créer des stratégies et des conseils internationaux en matière de tarification qui maximisent l'accès durable des patients et leur valeur à long terme.
• Élaborer des stratégies de négociation des payeurs et équiper les marchés prioritaires de discussions fructueuses sur le remboursement.
• S'associer à des équipes de recherche sur l'économie et les résultats en matière de santé pour produire des données probantes pertinentes en matière d'accès.
• Anticiper les tendances en matière de politique, de payeur et d'évaluation des technologies de la santé afin de cerner les risques et les possibilités d'accès.
• Collaborer à l'échelle des équipes des affaires médicales, du développement, du commerce, de la tarification et des pays pour faire progresser les priorités en matière d'accès.
• Représenter la valeur internationale et l'accès dans les forums de gouvernance interne et les engagements pertinents des intervenants externes.
• Gérer efficacement les ressources et les budgets, en alignant l'investissement sur les actifs immunologiques et les priorités en matière de maladies.

Exigences essentielles:
• Baccalauréat, maîtrise, docteur en pharmacie (PharmD), médecin (MD), ou diplôme équivalent en sciences de la vie, économie de la santé, santé, affaires, ou une discipline connexe.
• Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en accès au marché dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée appuyant et exécutant des stratégies de lancement réussies sur les marchés internationaux ou régionaux.
• Capacité démontrée de naviguer dans des organisations matricielles complexes et d'influencer divers groupes d'intervenants interfonctionnels.
• Expérience d'accès aux marchés à l'échelle mondiale ou ex-américaine avec succès démontré dans des environnements internationaux complexes.
• Expérience de l'élaboration de propositions sur la valeur du payeur, de stratégies d'accès aux données probantes et d'approches de remboursement pour les thérapies innovatrices.
• Expertise éprouvée dans les domaines de l'accès aux marchés, de la tarification, de l'économie de la santé et des résultats de la recherche, ou dans les disciplines d'accès stratégique connexes.
• Compétence en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée.

Exigences souhaitables:
• Expérience en immunologie, y compris une bonne compréhension du paysage du traitement immunologique, de l'environnement des payeurs et des défis liés à l'accès aux marchés.

Accessibilité et hébergement
Novartis s'engage à travailler avec toutes les personnes et à leur fournir des aménagements raisonnables. Si, en raison d'une maladie ou d'un handicap, vous avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de recrutement, ou afin de recevoir des informations plus détaillées sur les fonctions essentielles d'un poste, veuillez envoyer un e-mail à diversity.inclusion ch@novartis.com et nous faire savoir la nature de votre demande et vos coordonnées. Veuillez inclure le travail requis

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Are you passionate about shaping complex tax strategies that drive business growth and innovation? As Senior Manager Tax Planning, you will play a pivotal role in supporting Novartis' Swiss Tax Planning agenda, acting as a trusted advisor on tax planning, financing, structuring, transactions, and mergers and acquisitions. Working closely with Finance, Treasury, Corporate Legal, Global Tax, and business leaders, you will help influence high-impact strategic decisions while ensuring a sustainable and efficient tax position. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your expertise to complex Swiss and cross-border initiatives, collaborate with senior stakeholders, and contribute to the continued success of a global healthcare leader.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Support Swiss tax planning, structuring and reorganization initiatives to support business growth and transformation.

• Advise on cross-border transactions, intellectual property structures and value chain developments.

• Partner with Treasury and Legal on financing structures, bond issuances and funding arrangements.

• Support tax due diligence, risk assessments and structuring activities for mergers and acquisitions.

• Prepare, negotiate and manage tax rulings with Swiss Tax Authorities.

• Monitor tax risks, support audits and ensure compliance with Swiss tax legislation and policies.

• Build trusted relationships across Finance, Treasury, Legal, Global Tax and external advisors.

Essential Requirements

• Degree in Tax, Accounting, Finance, Law or a related discipline.

• Significant experience in Swiss corporate tax planning, structuring and financing matters.

• Strong knowledge of Swiss tax legislation and international tax principles.

• Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, due diligence and business restructuring projects.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Excellent analytical, communication and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic business-focused approach.

Desirable Requirements

• Professional Swiss tax qualification or equivalent advanced tax certification.

• Experience within a multinational organization supporting complex cross-border transactions and financing structures.

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel - Onsite
This role is not offering relocation. Please apply only if the location is accessible to you.
#LI-Onsite

Approximately 50% of the role is dedicated to laboratory automation support and operational excellence across IMM, while approximately 50% is focused on hands-on assay development, screening, profiling, and experimental support of drug discovery projects.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary IMM contact for laboratory automation systems and liquid handling platforms.

• Ensure reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of laboratory automation infrastructure.

• Provide rapid hands-on technical support and training to automation users across IMM.

• Develop, optimize, validate, and execute biochemical, cellular, and biophysical assays supporting drug discovery projects.

• Perform compound profiling and small- to medium-throughput screening campaigns using automated platforms.

• Analyze and communicate experimental results to project teams and stakeholders.

• Support assay automation, implementation, and transfer onto automated workflows.

• Collaborate closely with project teams to advance hit-to-lead and lead optimization activities.

• Maintain high scientific and operational standards, ensuring data quality and reproducibility.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Biotechnology, or a related field.

• At least three years of experience operating and troubleshooting laboratory automation and liquid handling platforms.

• Practical experience in biochemical and/or cellular assay development and execution.

• Demonstrates a service-oriented mindset by responding constructively to urgent support requests, maintaining a positive attitude, and providing reliable assistance on automation platforms and devices.

• Provide strategic oversight of IMM laboratory automation infrastructure by anticipating future scientific requirements, maintaining state-of-the-art instrumentation and software, and developing long-term automation solutions that support departmental objectives.

• Understanding of drug discovery workflows and hit-to-lead activities. Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to prioritize and support multiple users and projects simultaneously.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience with biophysical assay technologies (SPR, Dianthus)

• Experience with screening and profiling software such as Genedata Screener, Spotfire, and GraphPad Prism.

• Fluent in English, German, and French, with strong verbal and written communication skills

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• Switzerland: 65,870.00 - 122,330.00 CHF Annual

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and resp

Descrizione del lavoro Responsabilità chiave

• Agire come contatto primario IMM per sistemi di automazione di laboratorio e piattaforme di movimentazione liquidi.

• Garantire un funzionamento affidabile, manutenzione, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo delle infrastrutture di automazione di laboratorio.

• Fornire un rapido supporto tecnico e formazione agli utenti dell'automazione attraverso IMM.

• Sviluppare, ottimizzare, convalidare ed eseguire test biochimici, cellulari e biofisici a sostegno di progetti di scoperta di farmaci.

• Eseguire campagne di screening composto di rafano e piccolo a medio-media-throughput utilizzando piattaforme automatizzate.

• Analizzare e comunicare i risultati sperimentali ai team di progetto e agli stakeholder.

• Supporta l'automazione, l'implementazione e il trasferimento dei test su flussi di lavoro automatizzati.

• Collaborare strettamente con i team di progetto per promuovere attività di ottimizzazione e hit-to-lead.

• Mantenere elevati standard scientifici e operativi, garantendo la qualità e la riproducibilità dei dati.

Requisiti essenziali

• Laurea magistrale in Biologia, Biochimica, Farmacologia, Biotecnologie o un campo correlato.

• Almeno tre anni di esperienza nell'automazione e nella gestione dei problemi dei laboratori e delle piattaforme di movimentazione dei liquidi.

• Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e nell'esecuzione di saggi biochimici e/o cellulari.

• Dimostra una mentalità orientata al servizio rispondendo in modo costruttivo alle richieste urgenti di supporto, mantenendo un atteggiamento positivo e fornendo assistenza affidabile su piattaforme e dispositivi di automazione.

• Fornire una supervisione strategica dell'infrastruttura IMM di automazione di laboratorio anticipando i futuri requisiti scientifici, mantenendo la strumentazione e il software all'avanguardia e sviluppando soluzioni di automazione a lungo termine che supportino gli obiettivi dipartimentali.

• comprensione dei flussi di lavoro di ricerca di farmaci e attività di punta. Forte analisi dei dati e abilità di risoluzione dei problemi. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione. Capacità di dare priorità e sostenere più utenti e progetti contemporaneamente.

Requisiti desiderabili

• Esperienza con tecnologie di analisi biofisica (SPR, Dianthus)

• Esperienza con la proiezione e il software di rasoning come Genedata Screener, Spotfire e GraphPad Prism.

• Fluente in inglese, tedesco e francese, con forti capacità comunicative verbali e scritte

Environ 50 % du rôle est consacré au soutien de l'automatisation en laboratoire et à l'excellence opérationnelle dans l'ensemble de l'IMM, tandis qu'environ 50 % est axé sur le développement de tests pratiques, le dépistage, le profilage et l'appui expérimental de projets de découverte de médicaments.

• Agir comme contact principal IMM pour les systèmes d'automatisation de laboratoire et les plates-formes de traitement des liquides.

• Assurer un fonctionnement, une maintenance, un dépannage et une amélioration continue de l'infrastructure d'automatisation des laboratoires.

• Fournir un soutien technique et une formation rapides aux utilisateurs d'automatisation dans l'ensemble de l'IMM.

• Développer, optimiser, valider et exécuter des essais biochimiques, cellulaires et biophysiques à l'appui de projets de découverte de médicaments.

• Effectuer des campagnes de profilage composé et de dépistage à moyen et moyen terme à l'aide de plateformes automatisées.

• Analyser et communiquer les résultats expérimentaux aux équipes de projet et aux parties prenantes.

• Support de l'automatisation des essais, de la mise en œuvre et du transfert sur les workflows automatisés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de projet pour faire progresser les activités d'optimisation des résultats et des résultats.

• Maintenir des normes scientifiques et opérationnelles élevées, en assurant la qualité des données et leur reproductibilité.

Exigences essentielles

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en biologie, biochimie, pharmacologie, biotechnologie ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins trois ans d'expérience en fonctionnement et en dépannage de l'automatisation de laboratoire et des plates-formes de traitement des liquides.

• Expérience pratique en développement et exécution de tests biochimiques et/ou cellulaires.

• Démontre une mentalité orientée vers le service en répondant de façon constructive aux demandes urgentes de soutien, en maintenant une attitude positive et en fournissant une assistance fiable sur les plateformes et les appareils d'automatisation.

Single-cell and spatial omics technologies are transforming biomedical research by enabling deep characterization of complex biological systems at unprecedented resolution. These approaches provide unique insights into cellular heterogeneity, rare cell populations, disease mechanisms, and treatment responses across a wide range of preclinical and translational research applications.

Single-cell profiling plays a critical role in the development and validation of advanced experimental models, helping ensure that research systems are well characterized and biologically relevant. In addition, large-scale single-cell datasets are increasingly used to support data-driven discovery approaches, including the development of computational and artificial intelligence models for biological interpretation and target identification.

Complementing these capabilities, spatial transcriptomics enables the analysis of gene expression within intact tissue architecture, providing essential context on cellular organization, cell-cell interactions, and tissue responses. Together, single-cell and spatial technologies bridge discovery and translational research by linking molecular insights to biological function across diverse model systems and human samples.

We are seeking scientists who are passionate about applying cutting-edge omics technologies, leveraging large-scale datasets, and working at the interface of experimental biology, data science, and translational research to accelerate scientific innovation and therapeutic discovery.

Le tecnologie omiche monocellulari e spaziali stanno trasformando la ricerca biomedica consentendo una profonda caratterizzazione di sistemi biologici complessi a una risoluzione senza precedenti. Questi approcci forniscono informazioni uniche sull'eterogeneità cellulare, le popolazioni cellulari rare, i meccanismi delle malattie e le risposte di trattamento in una vasta gamma di applicazioni di ricerca preclinica e traduttiva.

La profilazione a singola cella svolge un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo e nella convalida di modelli sperimentali avanzati, aiutando a garantire che i sistemi di ricerca siano ben caratterizzati e biologicamente rilevanti. Inoltre, i dataset monocellulari su larga scala sono sempre più utilizzati per supportare approcci di scoperta basati sui dati, tra cui lo sviluppo di modelli di intelligenza computazionale e artificiale per l'interpretazione biologica e l'identificazione degli obiettivi.

Completando queste capacità, la trascrittura spaziale consente l'analisi dell'espressione genica all'interno di un'architettura dei tessuti intatta, fornendo un contesto essenziale sull'organizzazione cellulare, le interazioni cellulari e le risposte dei tessuti. Insieme, le tecnologie monocellulari e spaziali colmano la scoperta e la ricerca traduttiva collegando le intuizioni molecolari alla funzione biologica attraverso diversi sistemi di modelli e campioni umani.

Stiamo cercando scienziati che sono appassionati di applicare tecnologie all'avanguardia, sfruttando i set di dati su larga scala, e lavorando all'interfaccia di biologia sperimentale, scienza dei dati e ricerca traduttiva per accelerare l'innovazione scientifica e la scoperta terapeutica.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Sviluppare, valutare e implementare innovativi metodi e protocolli NGS, con l'accento sulla sequenziamento di RNA monocellulare e applicazioni multimodali spaziali o applicazioni multi-omiche per migliorare le capacità della piattaforma e fornire informazioni complete sui meccanismi della malattia e obiettivi terapeutici

• Indipendentemente eseguire esperimenti, analizzare i dati e generare report di alta qualità.

• Applicare rigore scientifico per garantire la generazione di dati conformi a FAIR.

• Collaborare con i team di laboratorio e bioinformatica bagnati per interpretare i set di dati di sequenziamento complessi e fornire informazioni attuabili ai team di progetto

• Protocolli e risultati attuali agli stakeholder interni

Requisiti essenziali:

• Laurea magistrale in Biochimica, Biologia Molecolare, Biotecnologia, Scienze della Vita, o una disciplina correlata con 1-2 anni di esperienza del settore specificamente in genomica, ibridazione in-situ, imaging e tecniche spaziali

• Esperienza diretta e dimostrabile con tecnologie molecolari avanzate, in particolare i flussi di lavoro Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)

• Eccezionale competenza nelle tecniche di biologia molecolare, tra cui l'estrazione di acido nucleico, PCR/qPCR e la preparazione della biblioteca NGS

• Esperienza di lavoro con i tipi di campione clinici impegnativi (ad esempio, tessuto FFPE, cellule tumorali primarie, campioni a basso consumo).

• Esperienza ed entusiasmo per lo sviluppo e la raffinazione di metodi sperimentali.

• Capacità di condurre in modo indipendente esperimenti, valutare i dati e comunicare i risultati in modo efficace.

• Hai un'eccezionale capacità di collaborare all'interno e all'interno dei team di matrice, consentendo un lavoro indipendente e di gruppo efficace in un ambiente diverso ed eterogeneo

Einzelzell- und räumliche Omiktechnologien verändern die biomedizinische Forschung, indem sie eine tiefe Charakterisierung komplexer biologischer Systeme mit beispielloser Auflösung ermöglichen. Diese Ansätze bieten einzigartige Einblicke in zelluläre Heterogenität, seltene Zellpopulationen, Krankheitsmechanismen und Behandlungsreaktionen in einer Vielzahl von präklinischen und translationalen Forschungsanwendungen.

Einzelzell-Profiling spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Validierung fortschrittlicher experimenteller Modelle und trägt dazu bei, dass Forschungssysteme gut charakterisiert und biologisch relevant sind. Darüber hinaus werden groß angelegte Einzelzelldatensätze zunehmend verwendet, um datengesteuerte Entdeckungsansätze zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Entwicklung von computergestützten und künstlichen Intelligenzmodellen für die biologische Interpretation und Zielidentifizierung.

Ergänzend zu diesen Fähigkeiten ermöglicht die räumliche Transkriptomik die Analyse der Genexpression innerhalb der intakten Gewebearchitektur und bietet einen wesentlichen Kontext für die zelluläre Organisation, Zell-Zell-Interaktionen und Gewebereaktionen. Gemeinsam verbinden Einzelzell- und räumliche Technologien Entdeckung und translationale Forschung, indem molekulare Erkenntnisse mit biologischen Funktionen über verschiedene Modellsysteme und menschliche Proben hinweg verknüpft werden.

Les technologies monocellulaires et spatiales transforment la recherche biomédicale en permettant une caractérisation profonde des systèmes biologiques complexes à une résolution sans précédent. Ces approches fournissent des renseignements uniques sur l'hétérogénéité cellulaire, les populations de cellules rares, les mécanismes de la maladie et les réponses au traitement dans un large éventail d'applications de recherche préclinique et translationnelle.

Le profilage monocellulaire joue un rôle crucial dans l'élaboration et la validation de modèles expérimentaux avancés, ce qui permet de s'assurer que les systèmes de recherche sont bien caractérisés et biologiquement pertinents. De plus, les ensembles de données monocellulaires à grande échelle sont de plus en plus utilisés pour appuyer les approches de découverte axées sur les données, y compris l'élaboration de modèles informatiques et d'intelligence artificielle pour l'interprétation biologique et l'identification des cibles.

En complétant ces capacités, la transcriptomique spatiale permet l'analyse de l'expression génique dans une architecture tissulaire intacte, fournissant un contexte essentiel sur l'organisation cellulaire, les interactions cellules-cellules et les réponses tissulaires. Ensemble, les technologies unicellulaires et spatiales relient la découverte et la recherche translationnelle en reliant les connaissances moléculaires à la fonction biologique dans divers systèmes modèles et échantillons humains.

Nous recherchons des scientifiques passionnés par l'application de technologies omiques de pointe, la mise à profit de ensembles de données à grande échelle et le travail à l'interface de la biologie expérimentale, de la science des données et de la recherche translationnelle pour accélérer l'innovation scientifique et la découverte thérapeutique.

Résumé de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Titre de l'emploi interne : Directeur
Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

Le directeur, Expert en médecine translationnelle (Neurodégénérescence) dirigera la fin de la stratégie translationnelle pour les programmes neurodégénératifs, reliant la recherche préclinique au développement clinique précoce (phase 1–2).
Ce rôle est responsable de la stratégie du biomarqueur, de la sélection des paramètres cliniques et de la conception des essais en phase initiale, permettant une prise de décision efficace et axée sur les données grâce à des étapes clés du développement (p. ex., les points de décision de transition) et assurant une différenciation concurrentielle des actifs neuromusculaires.
De plus, il supervise la planification, l'exécution et l'interprétation de la recherche sur les essais cliniques, des activités de collecte de données et des opérations cliniques. Établir et approuver des méthodes scientifiques pour la conception et la mise en oeuvre de protocoles cliniques, de systèmes de collecte de données et de rapports finaux. Appuyer la recherche clinique et les essais cliniques nouveaux et en cours et assurer le traitement efficace et en temps opportun des ententes de confidentialité et des ententes cliniques

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :
1. Stratégie translationnelle et leadership des programmes

•
• Définir et exécuter des stratégies translationnelles intégrées dans les programmes de neurodégénérescence

• Composants translationnels en plomb des études cliniques précliniques → Phase 1/2

• Diriger la progression du programme à travers les clés de décision (p. ex., IND, TDP, IDPA)

• Assurer un lien mécanique solide entre la biologie cible, les biomarqueurs et les paramètres cliniques

2. Biomarqueur et leadership final

•
• Collaborer avec des collègues de Biomarker Development pour élaborer et valider :
• Biomarqueurs moléculaires (tissus, sang, LCR le cas échéant)

• Paramètres fonctionnels (force, mobilité, mesures spécifiques à la maladie)

• Résultats déclarés par le patient

• Établir des biomarqueurs quantitatifs pour appuyer :
• Objectif

• Modification des maladies

• La sélection des doses et les décisions du PdC

• Intégrer la stratégie du biomarqueur dans les protocoles cliniques et les plans opérationnels

• Diriger le dérisquement du biomarqueur précoce , une priorité clé dans les programmes neuromusculaires

3. Développement clinique précoce (phase 1/2)

•
• Concevoir et exécuter des études cliniques précoces

• Définir :
• Stratégie d'escalade des doses

• Cadre d'exposition–réponse

• Paramètres translationnels (biopsie, imagerie, fonctionnalité)

• Assurer le leadership du MT au sein des équipes d'essais cliniques (ETC) pour :
• Modèle d'essai

• Contrôle de l'exécution

• Interprétation des données et prise de décisions

4. Leadership interfonctionnel

•
• Servir de représentant principal en médecine translationnelle au sein des équipes de projet mondiales

• Partenaire étroitement avec:
• Développement clinique

• Développement de biomarqueurs

• Pharmacologie clinique (SCP)

• Sécurité préclinique (SCP)

• Réglementation

• Favoriser l'alignement entre les organismes de recherche, de gestion et de développement

5. Leadership scientifique externe

•
• Établir et diriger des collaborations avec :
• KOLs universitaires

• Groupes de défense des patients (critiques dans les maladies neuromusculaires rares)

• Partenaires technologiques (imagerie, plateformes omiques)

• Contribuer à la stratégie scientifique et au positionnement externe des programmes

6. Développement des patients

•
• Intégrer la voix du patient dans les stratégies translationnelles et cliniques

• Avance :
• Paramètres fonctionnels significatifs

• Mesures des résultats pour les patients

• Approches d'essai novatrices (p. ex. modèles décentralisés lorsque c'est possible)

7. Contribution du portefeuille et apport stratégique

•
• Contribuer à:
• Priorité des actifs et stratégie de portefeuille

• Stratégie de différenciation concurrentielle (p. ex., par rapport aux concurrents de l'ARN ou de la thérapie génique)

• Fournir une contribution scientifique pour :
• Développement des entreprises / diligence raisonnable

• Stratégies d'expansion des indications

Exigences essentielles:
· MD, neurologues, formation clinique aux maladies neurodégénératives
· Expérience en médecine translationnelle, développement clinique précoce ou thérapeutique expérimentale.
· Capacité de façonner des stratégies de développement, d'effectuer des études cliniques précoces et d'influencer les règlements/paquets de soutien

Job Description Summary
Executive Clinical Program Leader - Translational Clinical Oncology

Location: Cambridge, MA, USA
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Employment Type: Full-Time

The Executive Clinical Program Leader (ECPL) provides strategic medical and scientific leadership for the development of multiple experimental agents within the Translational Clinical Oncology (TCO) portfolio. The role spans from early target identification through transition into later-stage development, partnering closely with development teams to accelerate decision-making and portfolio advancement. The ECPL also provides scientific and clinical expertise to evaluate external innovation opportunities and business development initiatives.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide strategic medical and scientific leadership across early oncology development programs.

• Represent Translational Clinical Oncology programs at internal governance and leadership boards.

• Lead clinical strategy development and provide senior clinical input for clinical studies and preclinical research projects.

• Review and provide feedback on key study documents, including protocols, investigator brochures, and regulatory submissions.

• Contribute scientific and clinical expertise to business development, licensing evaluations, and portfolio reviews.

• Lead and oversee external collaborations and strategic partnerships.

• Mentor colleagues and serve as an expert resource across Biomedical Research and the broader organization.

• Ensure the safe, ethical, and compliant conduct of clinical trials in accordance with GCP and company procedures.

• Engage with external experts, investigators, and health authorities in support of early oncology clinical development.

• Contribute to scientific publications, abstracts, and presentations for internal and external audiences.
Essential Requirements

• MD required; MD/PhD preferred.

• Board certification (or equivalent expertise) in Hematology-Oncology.

• 7+ years of experience leading complex global early-phase hematology-oncology clinical programs within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong experience in translational hematology/oncology and clinical research.

• Recognized scientific and clinical expertise demonstrated through publications and professional contributions.

• Broad knowledge of oncology drug development and clinical trial execution.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Proven leadership and people management experience.

• Strong mentoring and talent development capabilities.

• High ethical standards and commitment to improving outcomes for patients with cancer

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• Switzerland: 169,400.00 - 314,600.00 CHF Annual

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

• Lead and oversee external collaborations and strategic partnerships.

• Mentor colleagues and serve as an expert resource across Biomedical Research and the broader organization.

• Ensure the safe, ethical, and compliant conduct of clinical trials in accordance with GCP and company procedures.

• Engage with external experts, investigators, and health authorities in support of early oncology clinical development.

• Contribute to scientific publications, abstracts, and presentations for internal and external audiences.
Essential Requirements

• MD required; MD/PhD preferred.

• Board certification (or equivalent expertise) in Hematology-Oncology.

• 7+ years of experience leading complex global early-phase hematology-oncology clinical programs within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong experience in translational hematology/oncology and clinical research.

• Recognized scientific and clinical expertise demonstrated through publications and professional contributions.

• Broad knowledge of oncology drug development and clinical trial execution.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Proven leadership and people management experience.

• Strong mentoring and talent development capabilities.

• High ethical standards and commitment to improving outcomes for patients with cancer

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

• Switzerland: 169,400.00 - 314,600.00 CHF Annual

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Pricing & Contracting
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF179,200.00 - CHF332,800.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: Yes

Are you ready to shape the future of pricing and market access for innovative medicines on a global scale?

As Executive Director Pricing & Contracting, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the Immunology portfolio, driving pricing and contracting strategies that maximize patient access and optimize the long-term value of Novartis assets. Reporting to the Head of Pricing, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and a strategic partner to Therapeutic Areas, Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Finance, Strategy & Growth, and key markets worldwide. Leading a high-performing team of pricing and contracting experts, you will develop innovative launch and in-market pricing strategies, influence critical business decisions, and strengthen Novartis' position in an increasingly complex global reimbursement landscape. This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic leadership, market insight, and commercial acumen to help bring transformative medicines to patients around the world.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a high-performing Pricing & Contracting team while fostering innovation, talent growth, and organizational excellence.

• Develop and execute global pricing and contracting strategies that maximize access and long-term brand value.

• Serve as a trusted pricing advisor and strategic partner to priority countries and senior leadership teams.

• Partner across Therapeutic Areas, Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Finance, and Strategy & Growth functions.

• Guide countries on pricing scenario analyses, innovative contracting approaches, and reimbursement strategies.

• Shape launch sequencing, pricing governance, and price implementation strategies across global markets.

• Monitor pricing policy developments, reimbursement trends, and market dynamics to identify risks and opportunities.

• Lead strategic pricing projects and generate actionable insights to support business-critical decisions.

Essential Requirements:

• 10+ years of senior-level experience in pharmaceutical companies, Health Technology Assessment agencies, healthcare consultancies, or related organizations.

• Extensive experience in pricing, market access, and commercial strategy across multiple brands and therapeutic areas.

• Strong above-country experience, including regional or global pricing and access responsibilities.

• Proven people leadership experience, including leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights and recommendations.

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and financial understanding.

• Demonstrated success working across functions, including Therapeutic Areas, Value & Access, Strategy & Growth, and Finance teams.

• Experience preparing and negotiating reimbursement submissions, Health Technology Assessment engagements, and pricing strategies with payers in major markets, with proficient English both written and spoken.

Desirable Requirements:

• Advanced degree such as a Doctor of Philosophy, Master's degree, or equivalent qualification in Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, Health Policy, Health Economics, or a related field.

• Experience within the Immunology therapeutic area.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF150,500.00 - CHF279,500.00

Job Description Summary
Location Basel, Switzerland
#LI-Hybrid 3 days/week in office
Internal Job Title: Director, Deployment Strategist, Applied AI

The Enterprise AI & Reimagine Work team is a central group helping shape and accelerate AI-enabled ways of working across the enterprise. We partner with business units and functions to turn leadership priorities into focused action, scale high-impact initiatives, unblock execution, and build reusable solutions that help teams work smarter. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise transformation, AI, and hands-on problem solving

Job Description
Main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Independently drive strategic tech/AI projects for Novartis Group, the CEO and the Executive Committee

• Drive value by defining cross-cutting solutions (including cross-functional working groups, tech products) that will enable AI to fully scale in the business

• Generate strategic insights based on best-in-class analysis, distill outputs and recommendations which enable informed decisions of top-level leaders on AI and Reimagining Work

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for the team on select tech related topics

• Develop network of tech/AI experts and leaders across Novartis

What you'll bring to the role:

• Bachelor’s degree, advanced degree preferred (MS, MBA)

• Proficiency in English required (spoken and written) with proficiency in other languages a plus

• Hands on experience (e.g., 2 years) in digital/AI related fields e.g., product management, digital analytics, building software products

• Established record of driving strategic AI/digital transformation and topics with value creation in mind

• Significant experience gained in a top tier consultancy (manager level)

• Project and program management experience in strategic projects, ideally in pharma/healthcare with a track record of strong business impact

• Effective and persuasive communicator with strong presentation, communication (both written and verbal), influencing and negotiation skills.

• Ability to work with and lead multi-disciplinary teams including engineers, architects· Experience in executive level communications.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally, to be determined based on business needs.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 150,500.00 - 215,000.00 - 279,500.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Job Description Summary
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Start date: November 1, 2026 or earlier
Application deadline: September 24, 2026 EOB

Job Description
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join the AI & Innovation team within Oncology Data Science at Novartis in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
Working closely with pathologists, translational scientists, and drug discovery teams, you will gain exposure to the end-to-end oncology research process, from biological hypothesis generation and biomarker discovery to translational decision-making. Your project will focus on advancing AI-enabled digital pathology approaches to extract clinically and biologically meaningful insights from complex tissue imaging datasets, including H&E, IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial transcriptomics. In close collaboration with computational, pathology, and translational teams, you will help identify robust image-derived biomarkers and interpret spatial and cellular patterns in the tumor microenvironment to support next-generation oncology therapeutics.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders and power the future of medicine through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, including the implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network
We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.
This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

Reimagining Medicine Together
At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and apply AI approaches to extract insights from digital pathology imaging datasets (e.g., H&E, IHC, mIF, Spatial transcriptomics).

• Work with foundational models, including pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose, and multi-modal models to advance generative AI applications in drug discovery.

• Collaborate with pathologists and translational teams to interpret image-derived biomarkers and biological findings.

• Contribute to scientific publications and present

Lavorando a stretto contatto con patologi, scienziati traduttivi e team di scoperta della droga, si otterrà l'esposizione al processo di ricerca oncologia end-to-end, dalla generazione di ipotesi biologica e la scoperta del biomarcatore al processo decisionale traduttivo. Il vostro progetto si concentrerà sull'avanzare approcci di patologia digitale abilitati all'IA per estrarre intuizioni clinicamente e biologicamente significative da complessi dataset di imaging dei tessuti, tra cui H&E, IHC, immunofluorescenza multiplex e trascrizione spaziale. In stretta collaborazione con team computazionali, patologia e traduttivi, vi aiuterà a identificare i biomarcatori robusti e a interpretare i modelli spaziali e cellulari nel microambiente tumorale per supportare i terapeutici oncologici di nuova generazione.

Perché partecipare al programma?
Il Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program è progettato per sviluppare la prossima generazione di leader scientifici e il potere il futuro della medicina attraverso una ricerca rigorosa e esperienze di apprendimento immersivo, tra cui l'implementazione di strumenti AI nella ricerca biomedica.
I membri della ricerca postdoctoral beneficiano di:

• Guida da leader scientifici e esperti di materia

• Accesso a tecnologie, piattaforme e capacità di ricerca avanzate

• Collaborazione tra discipline e confini organizzativi

• Una comunità globale e diversificata di compagni postdottoriali

• Programmazione dedicata progettata per aiutare gli altri a prosperare durante la loro carriera.

• Opportunità di apprendimento esperienziale personalizzate attraverso un Pratico Postdoc che consente ai compagni di esplorare nuovi domini scientifici, costruire competenze trasversali e espandere il loro impatto oltre il loro progetto di ricerca primaria.

• Opportunità di presentare la ricerca, pubblicare su riviste leader e costruire una rete scientifica internazionale
Stiamo entrando in una nuova era di scoperte della ricerca biomedica attraverso la convergenza di biologia, tecnologia e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale, e i compagni sono anche sostenuti nell'impegno con questi approcci emergenti.
Questa è una posizione di formazione a tempo pieno fino a tre anni di durata.

Reimmaginare la medicina insieme
A Novartis, il nostro scopo è quello di riimmaginare la medicina per migliorare ed estendere la vita delle persone. Attraverso questo programma, crescerai come scienziato e futuro leader, contribuendo a scoperte che possono finalmente beneficiare i pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Principali responsabilità

• Sviluppare e applicare approcci AI per estrarre informazioni dai dataset di digital paology imaging (ad esempio, H&E, IHC, mIF, Spatial transcriptomics).

• Lavorare con modelli di base, tra cui pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose e modelli multi-modali per avanzare applicazioni AI generative nella scoperta della droga.

• Collabora con patologi e team traduttivi per interpretare i biomarcatori derivati dalle immagini e i risultati biologici.

• Contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche e risultati attuali all'interno

Job Description Summary
We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Duration: 3 years
Start date: November 1, 2026 or earlier
Application deadline: September 24, 2026 EOB

Job Description
As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join the AI & Innovation team within Oncology Data Science at Novartis in Basel and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.
Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.

Research Opportunity
Working closely with pathologists, translational scientists, and drug discovery teams, you will gain exposure to the end-to-end oncology research process, from biological hypothesis generation and biomarker discovery to translational decision-making. Your project will focus on advancing AI-enabled digital pathology approaches to extract clinically and biologically meaningful insights from complex tissue imaging datasets, including H&E, IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial transcriptomics. In close collaboration with computational, pathology, and translational teams, you will help identify robust image-derived biomarkers and interpret spatial and cellular patterns in the tumor microenvironment to support next-generation oncology therapeutics.

Why Join the Program?
The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders and power the future of medicine through rigorous research, and immersive learning experiences, including the implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.
Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

• Guidance from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts

• Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities

• Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries

• A global and diverse community of postdoctoral fellows

• Dedicated programming designed to help fellows thrive throughout their careers.

• Personalized experiential learning opportunities through a Postdoc Practicum that empower fellows to explore new scientific domains, build cross-functional expertise, and expand their impact beyond their primary research project.

• Opportunities to present research, publish in leading journals, and build an international scientific network
We are entering a new era of biomedical research breakthroughs through the convergence of biology, technology, and artificial intelligence tools, and fellows are also supported in engaging with these emerging approaches.
This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

Reimagining Medicine Together
At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. Through this program, you will grow as a scientist and future leader while contributing to discoveries that may ultimately benefit patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and apply AI approaches to extract insights from digital pathology imaging datasets (e.g., H&E, IHC, mIF, Spatial transcriptomics).

• Work with foundational models, including pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose, and multi-modal models to advance generative AI applications in drug discovery.

• Collaborate with pathologists and translational teams to interpret image-derived biomarkers and biological findings.

• Contribute to scientific publications and present

Stellenbeschreibung
Als Postdoktorand werden Sie dem AI & Innovation-Team von Oncology Data Science bei Novartis in Basel beitreten und ein innovatives Forschungsprojekt an der Spitze der biomedizinischen Wissenschaft und Wirkstoffforschung verfolgen. Sie arbeiten mit führenden Wissenschaftlern in einem hochgradig kooperativen, multidisziplinären Umfeld zusammen und sind gleichzeitig dem breiteren Ökosystem ausgesetzt, das wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen in Medikamente übersetzt.
Unsere Stipendiaten sind in der Lage, mutige wissenschaftliche Fragen zu stellen, innovative Technologien anzuwenden und Ansätze zu entwickeln, die das Potenzial haben, die Patientenversorgung zu verändern.

Forschungsmöglichkeit
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Pathologen, Translationswissenschaftlern und Wirkstoffforschungsteams werden Sie dem end-to-end-onkologischen Forschungsprozess ausgesetzt sein, von der biologischen Hypothesenerzeugung und Biomarkerentdeckung bis hin zur translationalen Entscheidungsfindung. Ihr Projekt wird sich auf die Weiterentwicklung von KI-fähigen digitalen Pathologieansätzen konzentrieren, um klinisch und biologisch bedeutsame Erkenntnisse aus komplexen Gewebebildgebungsdatensätzen zu extrahieren, darunter H & E, IHC, Multiplex-Immunfluoreszenz und räumliche Transkriptomik. Warum dem Programm beitreten?
Das Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program wurde entwickelt, um die nächste Generation von wissenschaftlichen Führungskräften zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Medizin durch strenge Forschung und immersive Lernerfahrungen, einschließlich der Implementierung von KI-Tools in der biomedizinischen Forschung, voranzutreiben.

Dies ist eine Vollzeit-Ausbildungsstelle von bis zu drei Jahren Dauer.

Medizin gemeinsam neu gestalten
Bei Novartis ist es unser Ziel, die Medizin neu zu gestalten, um das Leben der Menschen zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Durch dieses Programm werden Sie als Wissenschaftler und zukünftiger Führer wachsen und gleichzeitig zu Entdeckungen beitragen, die letztendlich Patienten weltweit zugute kommen können.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Entwicklung und Anwendung von KI-Ansätzen zur Gewinnung von Erkenntnissen aus digitalen Pathologie-Bildgebungsdatensätzen (z. B. H & E, IHC, mIF, Spatial Transkriptomik).

• Arbeiten Sie mit grundlegenden Modellen, einschließlich vortrainierter, selbstüberwachter, Mehrzweck- und multimodaler Modelle, um generative KI-Anwendungen in der Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Pathologen und Translationsteams zusammen, um bildabgeleitete Biomarker und biologische Ergebnisse zu interpretieren.

• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und präsentieren Ergebnisse bei internen

Nous sommes heureux d'inviter des candidats au programme de bourses postdoctorales de recherche biomédicale de Novartis, une occasion unique de formation conçue pour les scientifiques exceptionnels en début de carrière désireux de s'attaquer à certains des problèmes les plus difficiles en recherche biomédicale et en découverte de médicaments.
